MinerU文本RAG与PyMuPDF结构版：32题对照

MinerU新答题32题，新版有效评分63/64。主对照为PyMuPDF结构版81块；保留原44块与DSH作为补充。

本轮判断：当前PyMuPDF结构版的必答要点与五项同时达标数在两位裁判下均更高，暂不切换默认索引。实验批次20261029，2026-10-30完成报告。

同一论文、题目、标准答案、评分规则、Embedding、答题模型及检索设置。原生块适配方式不同，不能将差异单独归因于解析器。只做文本问答，没有增加视觉模型或重排。

主对照：每位裁判的相同有效题目

评委流程必答要点事实完全支持单条引用有效引用组完整边界 / 2五项同时达标
lunaPyMuPDF结构版81块97.14%125/128 (97.66%)136/138 (98.55%)116/128 (90.62%)1.84423/32
lunaMinerU原生文本117块91.41%108/112 (96.43%)120/122 (98.36%)104/112 (92.86%)1.75020/32
jevPyMuPDF结构版81块95.83%118/118 (100.00%)122/125 (97.60%)115/118 (97.46%)1.93322/30
jevMinerU原生文本117块91.11%107/108 (99.07%)114/115 (99.13%)105/108 (97.22%)1.86720/30

luna：32题；必答要点变化-5.73个百分点，提高1题，下降4题。

jev：30题；必答要点变化-4.72个百分点，提高1题，下降3题。

上述比率采用各自的事实、引用与题目分母，不相加为综合正确率。API失败或评分无效属于缺失，不计为答案零分。既有对照评分复用；单篇论文、单轮新回答不代表普遍性能或稳定性。

[
  {
    "ref": "[2]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Reﬁning\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp ﬁbers were obtained from\nZhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI reﬁner\n(Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency\nof 10%, the gap between the opposite reﬁning plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were\n3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp\nﬁbers were separately reﬁned in a PFI reﬁner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and\nat 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an\nincreasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood ﬁbers and 0,\n26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\nThe ﬁnes content, weighted mean length, and macro-ﬁbrillation index of each sample were\ndetermined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of\ndry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT\n12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus\n(Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361.",
    "verification": {
      "status": "frozen_chunk_metadata_verified"
    }
  }
]

    "text": "2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Refining\n\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets",

DSH归档对照

DSH

该论文研究的两类纸浆是漂白硫酸盐针叶木浆和漂白硫酸盐阔叶木浆，分别对应文中的 softwood pulp fibers 与 hardwood pulp fibers [1]。
原料经过漂白，论文明确称其为商品漂白浆（commercial bleached pulp）[1]。
制浆方法为硫酸盐法（kraft），因此这两种浆分别是漂白硫酸盐针叶木浆和漂白硫酸盐阔叶木浆 [1]。

  {
    "ref": "[1]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Reﬁning\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp ﬁbers were obtained from\nZhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI reﬁner\n(Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency\nof 10%, the gap between the opposite reﬁning plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were\n3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp\nﬁbers were separately reﬁned in a PFI reﬁner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and\nat 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an\nincreasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood ﬁbers and 0,\n26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\nThe ﬁnes content, weighted mean length, and macro-ﬁbrillation index of each sample were\ndetermined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of\ndry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT\n12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus\n(Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361.",
    "verification": {
      "status": "frozen_chunk_metadata_verified"
    }
  }
]

  {
    "ref": "[1]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Refining\n\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets",

因此两类纸浆各有 5 个 PFI 打浆转数水平。 [1]

  {
    "ref": "[1]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Reﬁning\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp ﬁbers were obtained from\nZhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI reﬁner\n(Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency\nof 10%, the gap between the opposite reﬁning plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were\n3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp\nﬁbers were separately reﬁned in a PFI reﬁner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and\nat 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an\nincreasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood ﬁbers and 0,\n26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\nThe ﬁnes content, weighted mean length, and macro-ﬁbrillation index of each sample were\ndetermined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of\ndry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT\n12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus\n(Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361.",
    "verification": {
      "status": "frozen_chunk_metadata_verified"
    }
  }
]

PFI2-004 · PFI打到12000转的时候，针叶木浆和阔叶木浆的打浆度各是多少？那我们以后想要63 °SR左右的浆，是不是直接打12000转就行了？

参考答案与评分要点
方法部分给出的12000转对应针叶木63 °SR、阔叶木57 °SR。相同转数在本文不同浆种/条件下得到的打浆度不同，不能据此建立适用于所有纸浆的唯一换算。两类浆的作用力也不同，不能把差异全部归因于浆种。

PyMuPDF结构版81块

在PFI打到12000转时，针叶木浆的打浆度为63 °SR。 [1]
在同一研究中，阔叶木浆在12000转时的打浆度为57 °SR。 [1]
该研究将0、4000、8000、12000、16000转依次对应为针叶木浆16、20、40、63、79 °SR，以及阔叶木浆0、26、40、57、70 °SR。 [1]
因此，要达到约63 °SR不能只依据固定12000转，因为该转数下两种浆的打浆度并不相同。 [1]
研究中针叶木和阔叶木的PFI每杆长作用力分别为3.33 N/mm和1.77 N/mm，表明两种浆的打浆条件并不相同。 [1]

    "text": "2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Reﬁning\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp ﬁbers were obtained from\nZhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI reﬁner\n(Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency\nof 10%, the gap between the opposite reﬁning plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were\n3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp\nﬁbers were separately reﬁned in a PFI reﬁner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and\nat 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an\nincreasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood ﬁbers and 0,\n26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\nThe ﬁnes content, weighted mean length, and macro-ﬁbrillation index of each sample were\ndetermined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of\ndry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT\n12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus\n(Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361.",

      "status": "frozen_chunk_metadata_verified"
    }
  }

在该文的PFI打浆条件下，针叶木浆在12000转时的打浆度为63 °SR。 [1]
同样在12000转时，阔叶木浆的打浆度为57 °SR。 [1]
因此，想要63 °SR左右的浆不能仅凭12000转直接套用；该转数只与针叶木浆的63 °SR相对应，而阔叶木浆在12000转约为57 °SR，且打浆度还取决于浆种和具体PFI条件，需实际试打并检测。 [1]

    "text": "2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Refining\n\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets",

DSH归档对照

DSH

按论文数据，PFI打到12,000转时，针叶木浆的打浆度为63 °SR，阔叶木浆为57 °SR。[1][2][3][4]
这一对应来自论文的方法部分：两种浆分别在0、4000、8000、12,000和16,000转下打浆，打浆度以Schopper–Riegler值（°SR，按ISO 5267-1测定）表征，并按转数递增的顺序列出针叶木浆16、20、40、63、79 °SR和阔叶木浆0、26、40、57、70 °SR，其中63 °SR与57 °SR都在第4个位置，即12,000转；论文没有单列“转数—打浆度”对照表，上述配对由该递增序列和Figure 2的柱状图（12,000转处约为63 °SR与57 °SR）共同确定。[1][2][3][4][5]
所以“以后想要63 °SR左右的浆就直接打12,000转”不能一概照搬：12,000转只在针叶木浆上对应63 °SR，阔叶木浆在12,000转只有57 °SR，比针叶木浆低6 °SR；论文中阔叶木浆在16,000转为70 °SR，故用阔叶木浆打到63 °SR所需转数应落在12,000–16,000转之间，具体数值论文未给出。[2][3][4]
打浆度还与浆种和打浆条件有关：本研究的条件为浆浓10%、磨盘间隙0.2 mm、针叶木浆与阔叶木浆的比压分别为3.33 N/mm和1.77 N/mm，论文还把阔叶木浆部分形貌参数变化不显著归因于“施加在阔叶木浆上的打浆压力较低”；换一批浆或改变这些条件后，同一转数对应的打浆度会不同，因此12,000转不是得到63 °SR的通用设定（此推广属推断）。[6][7]
操作上更可靠的做法（推断，论文未提出该结论）是：把打浆度本身作为终点指标，按ISO 5267-1边打边测SR，达到约63 °SR即停；论文数据显示打浆度随PFI转数显著上升，转数只能作为接近目标SR的参考。[5][8]
另外（推断），打浆度相同不等于超分子结构相同：论文中两种浆的结晶度指数随打浆先下降、再上升、随后又下降，并非随打浆度单调变化；同为12,000转时，针叶木浆的CI-XI为70.93%、阔叶木浆为74.57%。若63 °SR只是滤水性能指标，按SR控制打到该值即可；若还要求结晶区与氢键网络的可比状态，仅凭打浆度和转数无法判断。[9][10][11]

      "text": "所以“以后想要63 °SR左右的浆就直接打12,000转”不能一概照搬：12,000转只在针叶木浆上对应63 °SR，阔叶木浆在12,000转只有57 °SR，比针叶木浆低6 °SR；论文中阔叶木浆在16,000转为70 °SR，故用阔叶木浆打到63 °SR所需转数应落在12,000–16,000转之间，具体数值论文未给出。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E03",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood fibers."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C4",
      "text": "打浆度还与浆种和打浆条件有关：本研究的条件为浆浓10%、磨盘间隙0.2 mm、针叶木浆与阔叶木浆的比压分别为3.33 N/mm和1.77 N/mm，论文还把阔叶木浆部分形貌参数变化不显著归因于“施加在阔叶木浆上的打浆压力较低”；换一批浆或改变这些条件后，同一转数对应的打浆度会不同，因此12,000转不是得到63 °SR的通用设定（此推广属推断）。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "E01",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively."
      }

    {
      "id": "C5",
      "text": "操作上更可靠的做法（推断，论文未提出该结论）是：把打浆度本身作为终点指标，按ISO 5267-1边打边测SR，达到约63 °SR即停；论文数据显示打浆度随PFI转数显著上升，转数只能作为接近目标SR的参考。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "E05",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The WRV was determined with 0.5 g samples (o.d.) according to ISO 23714. (m1 −m2) WRV(%) = × 100% (1) m2 where m1 is the weight of the sample after centrifugation and m2 is the weight of the oven-dried sample."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C6",
      "text": "另外（推断），打浆度相同不等于超分子结构相同：论文中两种浆的结晶度指数随打浆先下降、再上升、随后又下降，并非随打浆度单调变化；同为12,000转时，针叶木浆的CI-XI为70.93%、阔叶木浆为74.57%。若63 °SR只是滤水性能指标，按SR控制打到该值即可；若还要求结晶区与氢键网络的可比状态，仅凭打浆度和转数无法判断。",

纤维形态采用 MORFI LB 分析仪（Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France）测定。 [1]
论文明确列出的三个形态指标是细小纤维含量（fines content）、加权平均长度（weighted mean length）和宏细纤维化指数（macro-fibrillation index）。 [1]
其中宏细纤维化指数用于表征外部宏细纤维化。 [4]

    "text": "2.1. PFI Reﬁning\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp ﬁbers were obtained from\nZhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI reﬁner\n(Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency\nof 10%, the gap between the opposite reﬁning plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were\n3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp\nﬁbers were separately reﬁned in a PFI reﬁner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and\nat 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an\nincreasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood ﬁbers and 0,\n26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\nThe ﬁnes content, weighted mean length, and macro-ﬁbrillation index of each sample were\ndetermined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of\ndry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT\n12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus\n(Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361.",

    }

    "page_end": 4,
    "text": "3. Results and Discussions\n\n3.1. The Morphological Analysis, Swelling, and Mechanical Properties\nFor softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, the macro-ﬁbrillation index and the ﬁber length had\na downward trend, and the ﬁnes content has an upward trend for the softwood ﬁbers during PFI\nreﬁning, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-ﬁbrillation index and ﬁber length of softwood ﬁbers\nchanged signiﬁcantly. However, two parameters of hardwood ﬁbers had no signiﬁcant variations\nrelative to softwood ﬁbers. It might be because of the lower reﬁning pressure that was applied in\nhardwood ﬁbers. The macro-ﬁbrillation index characterizes external macro-ﬁbrillation. The results of\nﬁber morphology analysis showed that external ﬁbrillation increased with the reﬁning process. It is\nconsistent with the increasing speciﬁc surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource).\n\nFigure 1. The morphological analysis for the unreﬁned and reﬁned samples: (a) softwood ﬁbers and\n(b) hardwood ﬁbers.\nThe beating degree and the WRV had a signiﬁcant increment with increasing PFI reﬁning\nrevolutions, as can be seen in Figure 2. It is caused by the higher ﬁbrillation that produces the\nnew surface and more pores (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource). The increase in swelling\ncharacterized by WRV makes the ﬁbers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to\nimproving the inter-ﬁber bonding strength of the ﬁber network. The results of ﬁber morphology\nanalysis and water retention value showing that the ﬁbrillation and the separation between ﬁbrils\nincrease with the reﬁning process.",

DSH归档对照

DSH

论文使用 MORFI LB 纤维形态分析仪（MORFI LB analyzer，Techpap SAS，法国格勒诺布尔）测定各试样的纤维形态。[1]
该方法明确列出的三个形态指标是：细料含量（fines content）、加权平均长度（weighted mean length）和宏观细纤维化指数（macro-fibrillation index）。[1]
结果与讨论部分同样围绕这三项指标随 PFI 打浆转数的变化展开（见图 1）：宏观细纤维化指数与纤维长度呈下降趋势，细料含量呈上升趋势（以软木浆纤维为例）。[2]

        "text": "The fines content, weighted mean length, and macro-fibrillation index of each sample were determined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of dry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT 12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus (Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C2",
      "text": "该方法明确列出的三个形态指标是：细料含量（fines content）、加权平均长度（weighted mean length）和宏观细纤维化指数（macro-fibrillation index）。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E04",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The fines content, weighted mean length, and macro-fibrillation index of each sample were determined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of dry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT 12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus (Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C3",
      "text": "结果与讨论部分同样围绕这三项指标随 PFI 打浆转数的变化展开（见图 1）：宏观细纤维化指数与纤维长度呈下降趋势，细料含量呈上升趋势（以软木浆纤维为例）。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E12",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "For softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, the macro-fibrillation index and the fiber length had a downward trend, and the fines content has an upward trend for the softwood fibers during PFI refining, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-fibrillation index and fiber length of softwood fibers changed significantly. However, two parameters of hardwood fibers had no significant variations relative to softwood fibers. It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. It is consistent with the increasing specific surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource)."
      }
    }

    "text": "Polymers 2020, 12, 2912 3 of 14\n\n2.3. Water Retention Value (WRV)\nThe WRV was determined with 0.5 g samples (o.d.) according to ISO 23714.\n(m1 −m2) WRV(%) = × 100% (1)\nm2\nwhere m1 is the weight of the sample after centrifugation and m2 is the weight of the oven-dried sample.\n\n2.4. XRD Analysis\nThe crystallinity of pretreated ﬁbers was determined by a Shimadzu XRD 7000S (Shimadzu,\nKyoto, Japan), while using Cu-Ka radiation. The samples were scanned at 40 kV and 30 mA in a 2θ\nrange of 4–40◦at 1◦/min. It is well known that two polymorphs, cellulose Iα and Iβ, are present in\nnative cellulose; for clarity, all of the reﬂections indexed here are on the Iβ lattice. Before analysis,\nthe experimental data is nine point smoothed with Savitzky–Golay algorithm. The two types of CI\nvalues were obtained from peak intensity method (CI −XI) and peak ﬁtting (CI-XA), respectively.\nThe CI −XI was calculated as in Equation (2) [19].\n(I200 −Iam) CI −XI = × 100% (2)\nI200\nwhere I200 is the maximum diﬀraction intensity value of the (200) lattice plane between the scattering\nangles of 2θ = 22◦and 23◦, and Iam is the minimum diﬀraction intensity of amorphous fraction between\n2θ = 18◦and 19◦.\nAll of the XRD diﬀractograms were smoothed with the Savitzky–Golay algorithm and\nbaseline-corrected with linear ﬁt function. Subsequently, the baseline-corrected diﬀractograms\nwere deconvoluted with the Pearson VII function. The value of the CI-XA equals the area percentage\noccupied by crystalline peaks over the total area of the diﬀraction pattern [20]. In addition, the crystallite\nsize was calculated by the widely used Scherrer Equation (3) [21]:\nk × λ\nL = (3)\n(β × cos θ)\nwhere L is the size that is perpendicular to the lattice plane, k is a constant that depends on the crystal\nshape (0.89), λ is the wavelength of the incident beam in the diﬀraction experiment (0.154 nm), β is the\nfull width at half maximum of the diﬀraction peak, and θ is the Bragg’s angle. In general, the values of\nthe calculated crystallite sizes might be lower than that of the real crystallite sizes, because the peak\nbroadening from the instrumental factors was not considered [22].\n\n2.5. FT-IR Analysis\nTHE FT-IR spectra were recorded on solid samples in KBr pellets by means of an FT-IR Bruker\nVertex 70 spectrometer (Karlsruhe, Germany). Unreﬁned and reﬁned ﬁbers were smashed into powder\nbetween 40 and 60 mesh. Subsequently, the powder sample of each species (5 mg) was dispersed in a\nmatrix of highly pure KBr (500 mg). The spectral was recorded by averaging 64 recordings and at a\nresolution of 4 cm−1 with transmission mode from 4000 cm−1 to 400 cm−1. The results were made on\nthe average spectrum that was obtained from ﬁve recordings.\nThe energy of the H-bonding EH for several OH stretching bands was calculated while using\nEquation (4) [13].\nνo −ν\nEH = (4)\nνo\nνo is the wavenumber corresponding to free OH groups (3650 cm−1), ν is the frequency (cm−1) of\nthe bonded OH groups, and k is a constant (1/k = 2.625 × 102 kJ).",

DSH归档对照

DSH

本文的WRV（Water Retention Value，保水值）用离心法测定：取0.5 g绝干（o.d.，oven-dried）浆样，按ISO 23714标准测定。 [1]
WRV按式(1)计算：WRV(%) = (m1 − m2)/m2 × 100%，即以百分数表示。 [2]
式中m1是离心后样品的质量，即离心后仍带水的湿样品质量。 [3]
m2是烘干（绝干）样品的质量，即绝干纤维本身的质量。 [3]
因此m1 − m2就是离心后样品中保留下来的水的质量；公式以m2（绝干质量）为分母作归一化，表示单位质量绝干纤维所保持的水量，再乘100%以百分数表示，即WRV可理解为每克绝干纤维所保水的质量百分比。 [2][3]
在本文中WRV被用作纤维润胀（swelling）的表征，并随PFI打浆转数的增加而显著增大（图2）。 [4][5]
不过，论文只说明按ISO 23714测定，未给出离心转速、离心时间等具体操作条件，这些细节在本文中无法确定。

      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E05",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The WRV was determined with 0.5 g samples (o.d.) according to ISO 23714. (m1 −m2) WRV(%) = × 100% (1) m2 where m1 is the weight of the sample after centrifugation and m2 is the weight of the oven-dried sample."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C2",
      "text": "WRV按式(1)计算：WRV(%) = (m1 − m2)/m2 × 100%，即以百分数表示。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E05",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The WRV was determined with 0.5 g samples (o.d.) according to ISO 23714. (m1 −m2) WRV(%) = × 100% (1) m2 where m1 is the weight of the sample after centrifugation and m2 is the weight of the oven-dried sample."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C3",
      "text": "式中m1是离心后样品的质量，即离心后仍带水的湿样品质量。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E05",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The WRV was determined with 0.5 g samples (o.d.) according to ISO 23714. (m1 −m2) WRV(%) = × 100% (1) m2 where m1 is the weight of the sample after centrifugation and m2 is the weight of the oven-dried sample."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C4",
      "text": "m2是烘干（绝干）样品的质量，即绝干纤维本身的质量。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E05",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The WRV was determined with 0.5 g samples (o.d.) according to ISO 23714. (m1 −m2) WRV(%) = × 100% (1) m2 where m1 is the weight of the sample after centrifugation and m2 is the weight of the oven-dried sample."

    {
      "id": "C5",
      "text": "因此m1 − m2就是离心后样品中保留下来的水的质量；公式以m2（绝干质量）为分母作归一化，表示单位质量绝干纤维所保持的水量，再乘100%以百分数表示，即WRV可理解为每克绝干纤维所保水的质量百分比。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",

PFI2-007 · CI-XI与CI-XA有什么区别？请给出本文CI-XI的公式，并说明CI-XA依据什么计算。

参考答案与评分要点
CI-XI用衍射峰强度计算：(I200−Iam)/I200×100%。CI-XA用晶区峰面积占总衍射面积的百分比计算，来自峰拟合。两者采用不同口径。

PyMuPDF结构版81块

本文中CI-XI由峰强度法获得，CI-XA由峰拟合获得。 [3]
本文CI-XI的公式为 CI-XI = (I200 − Iam) / I200 × 100%。 [3]
式中I200为2θ=22°–23°之间(200)晶面的最大衍射强度，Iam为2θ=18°–19°之间无定形部分的最小衍射强度。 [3]
CI-XA等于结晶峰面积占整个衍射图总面积的百分比。 [3]
CI-XA是在Savitzky–Golay平滑和线性基线校正后，用Pearson VII函数对基线校正后的衍射图进行解卷积后计算的。 [3]
CI-XI的值明显高于CI-XA，这可能是因为CI-XA分析中对无定形贡献的过度拟合。 [2]
CI-XI与CI-XA仍显著相关，软木纤维的相关系数为0.919（p < 0.05），硬木纤维为0.925（p < 0.05）。 [2]

luna：要点100.00%；事实7/7；引用7/7；引用组7/7；边界2/2。

MinerU原生文本117块

CI-XI和CI-XA是两种结晶度指数：前者采用峰强度法获得，后者采用峰拟合/峰面积法获得。 [3]
CI-XI值来自衍射强度之比，而CI-XA值来自峰面积之比。 [1]
本文CI-XI的计算公式为 CI-XI = ((I200 − Iam)/I200) × 100%；其中 I200 是 2Θ=22°–23° 之间(200)晶面的最大衍射强度，Iam 是 2Θ=18°–19° 之间无定形部分的最小衍射强度。 [3]
CI-XA依据峰拟合后的面积计算：其值等于结晶峰面积占整个衍射图谱总面积的百分比。 [3]
进行CI-XA分析前，衍射图经Savitzky–Golay平滑和线性基线校正，然后用Pearson VII函数对基线校正后的衍射图进行解卷积。 [3]
本文中CI-XI的值显著高于CI-XA，可能归因于CI-XA分析中对无定形贡献的过拟合。 [2]

(a) The CI of softwood fibers through refining. (b) The CI of hardwood fibers through refining.\n\n<sup>a</sup> The CI-XI value was obtained from the ratio of the difraction intensity. <sup>b</sup> The CI-XA value was obtained from the ratio of the peak areas.\n\n<table><tr><td colspan=\"6\">(a)</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=\"2\">Revolutions</td><td colspan=\"2\">CI (%)</td><td colspan=\"3\">Crystallite Size (nm)</td></tr><tr><td> $CI-XI^a$ </td><td> $CI-XA^b$ </td><td>110</td><td>(110)</td><td>(200)</td></tr><tr><td>0</td><td>73.23</td><td>40.46</td><td>3.2</td><td>3.5</td><td>4.5</td></tr><tr><td>4000</td><td>70.42</td><td>37.71</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.4</td><td>4.6</td></tr><tr><td>8000</td><td>72.54</td><td>39.65</td><td>3.2</td><td>3.4</td><td>4.6</td></tr><tr><td>12,000</td><td>70.93</td><td>36.22</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.7</td><td>4.7</td></tr><tr><td>16,000</td><td>69.82</td><td>34.20</td><td>3.2</td><td>3.5</td><td>4.7</td></tr><tr><td></td><td colspan=\"5\">(b)</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=\"2\">Revolutions</td><td colspan=\"2\">CI (%)</td><td colspan=\"3\">Crystallite Size (nm)</td></tr><tr><td> $CI-XI^a$ </td><td> $CI-XA^b$ </td><td>110</td><td>(110)</td><td>(200)</td></tr><tr><td>0</td><td>75.55</td><td>47.16</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.1</td><td>4.5</td></tr><tr><td>4000</td><td>73.01</td><td>36.26</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.3</td><td>4.7</td></tr><tr><td>8000</td><td>75.06</td><td>42.35</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.5</td><td>4.8</td></tr><tr><td>12,000</td><td>74.57</td><td>39.21</td><td>2.9</td><td>4.0</td><td>4.8</td></tr><tr><td>16,000</td><td>73.55</td><td>38.01</td><td>3.0</td><td>3.7</td><td>4.7</td></tr></table>\n\nThe trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.\n\nRecently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microfibrils with 18 cellulose chains [26]. Frequently adopted arrangements of the 18 cellulose chains are 234432, 34443, and 333333 [27]. Therein, 234432 arrangement was found to be more probable based on calculation [28].     "text": "2.4. XRD Analysis\n\nThe crystallinity of pretreated fibers was determined by a Shimadzu XRD 7000S (Shimadzu, Kyoto, Japan), while using Cu-Ka radiation. The samples were scanned at 40 kV and 30 mA in a 2θ range of $4 { - } 4 0 ^ { \\circ }$ at 1<sup>◦</sup>/min. It is well known that two polymorphs, cellulose Iα and Iβ, are present in native cellulose; for clarity, all of the reflections indexed here are on the Iβ lattice. Before analysis, the experimental data is nine point smoothed with Savitzky–Golay algorithm. The two types of CI values were obtained from peak intensity method (CI − XI) and peak fitting (CI-XA), respectively. The CI − XI was calculated as in Equation (2) [19].\n\n$$\nC I - X I = \\frac {\\left(I _ {2 0 0} - I _ {a m}\\right)}{I _ {2 0 0}} \\times 1 0 0 \\%\\tag{2}\n$$\n\nwhere I200 is the maximum difraction intensity value of the (200) lattice plane between the scattering angles of $2 \\Theta = 2 2 ^ { \\circ }$ and $2 3 ^ { \\circ }$ , and $I _ { a m }$ is the minimum difraction intensity of amorphous fraction between $2 \\Theta = 1 8 ^ { \\circ }$ and $1 9 ^ { \\circ }$\n\nAll of the XRD difractograms were smoothed with the Savitzky–Golay algorithm and baseline-corrected with linear fit function. Subsequently, the baseline-corrected difractograms were deconvoluted with the Pearson VII function. The value of the CI-XA equals the area percentage occupied by crystalline peaks over the total area of the difraction pattern [20]. In addition, the crystallite size was calculated by the widely used Scherrer Equation (3) [21]:\n\n$$\nL = \\frac {k \\times \\lambda}{(\\beta \\times \\cos \\theta)}\\tag{3}\n$$",

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

CI-XI是通过比较XRD峰强度得到的结晶度指数，CI-XA是通过比较XRD峰面积得到的结晶度指数。 [1]
本文的CI-XI按式(2)计算：CI-XI = (I200 − Iam) / I200 × 100%，其中I200为2θ = 22°–23°间(200)晶面的最大衍射强度，Iam为2θ = 18°–19°间无定形部分的最小衍射强度。 [7]
CI-XA依据峰面积计算：对经Savitzky–Golay平滑和基线校正后的XRD衍射图用Pearson VII函数去卷积，CI-XA等于晶峰面积占总衍射图面积的百分比。 [5]
文中指出CI-XI值明显高于CI-XA，这可能是由于CI-XA分析中对无定形贡献的过度拟合所致。 [2]

DSH归档对照

DSH

CI-XI 与 CI-XA 都是本文使用的结晶度指数（CI），但两者的计算依据不同：CI-XI 由峰强度法（peak intensity method）得到，CI-XA 由峰拟合（peak fitting）得到。[1]
本文 CI-XI 的计算公式为 CI−XI = (I200 − Iam)/I200 × 100%，即式(2)。[2]
式中 I200 为 2θ = 22°–23° 之间 (200) 晶面的最大衍射强度值，Iam 为 2θ = 18°–19° 之间非晶部分的最小衍射强度。[3]
按图4的说明，CI-XI 是通过比较 XRD 峰强度得到的结晶度指数，CI-XA 是通过比较 XRD 峰面积得到的结晶度指数；表1脚注同样说明 CI-XI 取自衍射强度的比值、CI-XA 取自峰面积的比值。[4][5]
CI-XA 依据 XRD 谱图的分峰拟合结果计算：所有谱图先经 Savitzky–Golay 算法平滑并用线性拟合进行基线校正，校正后的谱图再用 Pearson VII 函数解卷积，CI-XA 的数值等于结晶峰占整个衍射谱总面积的面积百分比。[6][7][8]
在本文数据中，CI-XI 的数值明显高于 CI-XA，这可能是由 CI-XA 分析中对非晶贡献的过拟合造成的；尽管如此，两者仍显著相关，软木纤维的相关系数为 0.919（p < 0.05），硬木纤维为 0.925（p < 0.05）。[9][10]

luna：要点100.00%；事实6/6；引用10/10；引用组6/6；边界2/2。

    "text": "Polymers 2020, 12, 2912 6 of 14\n\nFigure 4. The CI-XI (crystallinity index obtained by comparing intensity of X-ray diﬀractometer (XRD)\npeaks) and CI-XA (crystallinity index obtained by comparing area of XRD peaks) for reﬁned and\nunreﬁned samples: (a) softwood ﬁber and (b) hardwood ﬁber.\n\nTable 1. (a) The CI of softwood ﬁbers through reﬁning. (b) The CI of hardwood ﬁbers through reﬁning.\n(a)\nCI (%) Crystallite Size (nm)\nRevolutions a b CI-XI CI-XA 110 (110) (200)\n0 73.23 40.46 3.2 3.5 4.5\n4000 70.42 37.71 3.1 3.4 4.6\n8000 72.54 39.65 3.2 3.4 4.6\n12,000 70.93 36.22 3.1 3.7 4.7\n16,000 69.82 34.20 3.2 3.5 4.7\n(b)\nCI (%) Crystallite Size (nm)\nRevolutions a b CI-XI CI-XA 110 (110) (200)\n0 75.55 47.16 3.1 3.1 4.5\n4000 73.01 36.26 3.1 3.3 4.7\n8000 75.06 42.35 3.1 3.5 4.8\n12,000 74.57 39.21 2.9 4.0 4.8\n16,000 73.55 38.01 3.0 3.7 4.7\na The CI-XI value was obtained from the ratio of the diﬀraction intensity. b The CI-XA value was obtained from the\nratio of the peak areas.\n\nThe trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers were all similar,\ndecreasing ﬁrst and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The ﬂuctuation of the\nCI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI reﬁning on the diﬀerent regions of cellulose.\nIn the ﬁrst reﬁning stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in\nthe crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting\non the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical\nand thermal action of PFI reﬁning. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of\ncrystalline region.\nRecently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microﬁbrils with 18\ncellulose chains [26]. Frequently adopted arrangements of the 18 cellulose chains are 234432, 34443,\nand 333333 [27]. Therein, 234432 arrangement was found to be more probable based on calculation [28].\nThus, according to the crystallite sizes (as Table 1 shows) and the unit cell parameters of cellulose\nIβ, there was most likely to be an average of two-ﬁbrils with an arrangement of 234,432 packed\nside-by-side for both softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers (as seen in Figure 5, drawn with mercury",

The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.\n\nRecently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microfibrils with 18 cellulose chains [26]. The ﬂuctuation of the\nCI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI reﬁning on the diﬀerent regions of cellulose.\nIn the ﬁrst reﬁning stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in\nthe crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting\non the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical\nand thermal action of PFI reﬁning. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of\ncrystalline region.\nRecently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microﬁbrils with 18\ncellulose chains [26]. Frequently adopted arrangements of the 18 cellulose chains are 234432, 34443,\nand 333333 [27].     "text": "Figure 4. The CI-XI (crystallinity index obtained by comparing intensity of X-ray difractometer (XRD) peaks) and CI-XA (crystallinity index obtained by comparing area of XRD peaks) for refined and unrefined samples: (a) softwood fiber and (b) hardwood fiber.\n\nTable 1. (a) The CI of softwood fibers through refining. (b) The CI of hardwood fibers through refining.\n\n<sup>a</sup> The CI-XI value was obtained from the ratio of the difraction intensity. <sup>b</sup> The CI-XA value was obtained from the ratio of the peak areas.\n\n<table><tr><td colspan=\"6\">(a)</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=\"2\">Revolutions</td><td colspan=\"2\">CI (%)</td><td colspan=\"3\">Crystallite Size (nm)</td></tr><tr><td> $CI-XI^a$ </td><td> $CI-XA^b$ </td><td>110</td><td>(110)</td><td>(200)</td></tr><tr><td>0</td><td>73.23</td><td>40.46</td><td>3.2</td><td>3.5</td><td>4.5</td></tr><tr><td>4000</td><td>70.42</td><td>37.71</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.4</td><td>4.6</td></tr><tr><td>8000</td><td>72.54</td><td>39.65</td><td>3.2</td><td>3.4</td><td>4.6</td></tr><tr><td>12,000</td><td>70.93</td><td>36.22</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.7</td><td>4.7</td></tr><tr><td>16,000</td><td>69.82</td><td>34.20</td><td>3.2</td><td>3.5</td><td>4.7</td></tr><tr><td></td><td colspan=\"5\">(b)</td></tr><tr><td rowspan=\"2\">Revolutions</td><td colspan=\"2\">CI (%)</td><td colspan=\"3\">Crystallite Size (nm)</td></tr><tr><td> $CI-XI^a$ </td><td> $CI-XA^b$ </td><td>110</td><td>(110)</td><td>(200)</td></tr><tr><td>0</td><td>75.55</td><td>47.16</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.1</td><td>4.5</td></tr><tr><td>4000</td><td>73.01</td><td>36.26</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.3</td><td>4.7</td></tr><tr><td>8000</td><td>75.06</td><td>42.35</td><td>3.1</td><td>3.5</td><td>4.8</td></tr><tr><td>12,000</td><td>74.57</td><td>39.21</td><td>2.9</td><td>4.0</td><td>4.8</td></tr><tr><td>16,000</td><td>73.55</td><td>38.01</td><td>3.0</td><td>3.7</td><td>4.7</td></tr></table>\n\nThe trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.\n\nRecently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microfibrils with 18 cellulose chains [26]. Frequently adopted arrangements of the 18 cellulose chains are 234432, 34443, and 333333 [27]. Therein, 234432 arrangement was found to be more probable based on calculation [28]. DSH归档对照

DSH

论文中阔叶木（hardwood）纤维的数据列于表1(b)：未打浆（0转）时CI-XA为47.16%，打浆至8000转时为42.35%。[1][2][3]
下降的百分点数为：47.16 − 42.35 = 4.81 个百分点。[1][2]
相对降幅为：4.81 ÷ 47.16 × 100% ≈ 10.20%。[1][2]
CI-XA是按XRD峰面积占比定义的结晶度指数（表中数值单位为%），因此4.81是百分点差，10.20%是相对于0转初始值的相对降幅。[4]
旁证：论文正文称阔叶木的CI-XA在0至16,000转全程下降19.4%，与表中(47.16 − 38.01) ÷ 47.16 ≈ 19.4%相符，可确认该组数据属阔叶木。[5]

两种纤维垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸在PFI打浆过程中总体呈上升趋势。 [6]
软木纤维垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸从0转到16000转分别为4.5、4.6、4.6、4.7、4.7 nm。 [2]
硬木纤维垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸从0转到16000转分别为4.5、4.7、4.8、4.8、4.7 nm。 [2]

The ﬂuctuation of the\nCI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI reﬁning on the diﬀerent regions of cellulose.\nIn the ﬁrst reﬁning stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in\nthe crystalline region. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of\ncrystalline region.\nRecently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microﬁbrils with 18\ncellulose chains [26]. Frequently adopted arrangements of the 18 cellulose chains are 234432, 34443,\nand 333333 [27]. The result is consistent with the report of Haigler & Roberts [26], which shows that\nthere might be two microﬁbrils associated along part of their length.\n\nFigure 5. Cross-section model of cellulose crystallite for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers.\nIt is known that both the (110) and the (110) lattice plane are hydrophilic, and the (200)lattice\nplane is hydrophobic in cellulose Iβ (as Figure 5 shows). In addition, it is noticeable that the (110)\nplanes possess the highest theoretical roughness and accessibility to the hydrophilic groups in cellulose\nIβ [28]. Throughout the reﬁning of two pulp ﬁbers, the sizes perpendicular to (110) plane were more\nvolatile than the (110) plane and (200) plane, which is consistent with the report of Duchemin et al.,\nas shown in Table 1a,b [29]. It could be interpreted to be that water molecules were easier to permeate\nthrough the spaces between the hydrophilic (110) planes in paracrystalline region (hydration), and then\nit made these planes suﬀer more mechanical actions, so there was more adhesion (cocrystallization)\nand cleavage of cellulose chains created for (110) plane during PFI reﬁning.\nHowever, the crystallite size that was perpendicular to (200) lattice plane of two ﬁbers had an\nupward trend during PFI reﬁning. DSH归档对照

DSH

相对不打浆状态，两种纤维垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸在PFI打浆后都略有增大：不打浆（0转）时软木纤维和阔叶木纤维都是4.5 nm，打到16000转时两者都是4.7 nm，各增加0.2 nm（按表1数值计算，相对0转增幅约4.4%）。[1][2][3][9]
软木（针叶木）纤维从不打浆到16000转的(200)晶面晶粒尺寸依次为4.5、4.6、4.6、4.7、4.7 nm（分别对应0、4000、8000、12000、16000转），呈单调不减的上升。[1]
阔叶木纤维的对应数值依次为4.5、4.7、4.8、4.8、4.7 nm（分别对应0、4000、8000、12000、16000转），在8000–12000转达到最大值4.8 nm，16000转时回落到4.7 nm，但仍比不打浆时高0.2 nm。[2]
论文正文的概括是：两种纤维垂直于(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸在PFI打浆过程中呈上升趋势（upward trend）。[3]
作者把这一上升解释为：一方面是链的合并（coalescence）或相邻微纤丝的结晶堆叠、即干燥时(200)面趋于取向一致；另一方面是水分子难以渗入(200)面，使其受到的劈裂作用较弱。[4][5]
需要注意区分事实与概括：按表1的数值，阔叶木纤维在16000转时由4.8 nm回落至4.7 nm，并未持续上升，论文未单独解释这一回落；因此“上升趋势”是作者对整体变化的概括，而非逐点单调。[1][2][3]
作为对照，同一批样品的结晶度指数（CI-XI）整体下降：软木纤维由73.23%降到69.82%，阔叶木纤维由75.55%降到73.55%，即(200)方向晶粒尺寸略增与CI-XI下降同时发生。[1][2][8]
口径与局限：这里的晶粒尺寸是用XRD峰按Scherrer方程计算的、垂直于对应晶面方向的尺寸L（k=0.89，λ=0.154 nm）；作者指出该计算值可能低于真实晶粒尺寸，因为未扣除仪器因素造成的峰宽化。[6][7]

luna：要点100.00%；事实8/8；引用17/17；引用组7/8；边界2/2。

PFI2-011 · 是不是打浆转数越高，纤维素结晶度就越低？

参考答案与评分要点
不是单调下降。针叶木CI-XI从4000转70.42%升到8000转72.54%；阔叶木也从73.01%升到75.06%。0转到16000转总体下降，但过程中先降、回升、再降。

PyMuPDF结构版81块

不能简单认为打浆转数越高结晶度就越低；关于PFI打浆对纤维素结晶度的影响，文献结论并不一致。 [3]
有研究报道结晶度随打浆程度先升后降，或先波动上升再下降并重复波动，且此前研究未识别出明确趋势。 [4]
本研究中软木与硬木纤维的CI随PFI转数呈波动变化而非单调下降，例如软木CI-XI在0、4000、8000、12000、16000 r分别为73.23%、70.42%、72.54%、70.93%、69.82%。 [5]
总体而言，该研究认为PFI打浆过程中晶粒尺寸、结晶度和各类氢键含量总体变化不大，PFI打浆对超分子结构破坏相对较小。 [1]

luna：要点100.00%；事实4/4；引用4/4；引用组4/4；边界2/2。

Introduction\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired\nphysical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic ﬁbers. Therein,\nPapirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) reﬁning is the most common laboratory reﬁner in order to\nimprove the inter-ﬁber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-ﬁbrillated\nor nano-ﬁbrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main eﬀects of PFI reﬁning on ﬁbers are: (i) internal\nﬁbrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of ﬁber wall; (ii) external ﬁbrillation—peeling of\nﬁbrils from the ﬁber surface while remaining attached; (iii) ﬁber shortening—ﬁber cutting due to\nshearing action, and (iv) ﬁnes formation—primary ﬁnes come from ray cells and parenchyma cells\nand microﬁbrils that are caused by ﬁber shortening or external ﬁbrillation. Moreover, the PFI reﬁning\ncould be adopted to obtain a higher internal ﬁbrillation than other laboratory reﬁners [1]. These eﬀects\nof the PFI reﬁning on cellulosic ﬁbers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the ﬂexibility, and the\ninter-ﬁber bonding capacity of ﬁbers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and\nproperties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during reﬁning [7,8].\n\nThere are some diﬀerent conclusions regarding to the eﬀects of PFI reﬁning on crystallinity of\ncellulose, not like that of ball milling, which eﬀectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment\nprogresses. MinerU原生文本117块

PFI精磨对纤维素结晶度的影响存在不同结论：有研究报道结晶度下降，也有研究报道随精磨程度先升高后降低或波动，尚未识别出明确趋势。 [1]
本研究中软木浆和硬木浆的CI-XI与CI-XA在0、4000、8000、12000、16000转下并非随转数单调降低，而是出现下降后回升等波动。 [7]
总体而言，PFI精磨过程中微晶尺寸、结晶度和各种氢键含量变化不大。 [5]
研究还发现，PFI精磨过程中CI-XI与O(6)H···O(3')分子间氢键含量呈显著正相关。 [5]
因此，不能仅根据打浆转数升高直接推断纤维素结晶度必然降低，而需考虑具体浆种和精磨阶段。 [1] [7]

    "text": "1. Introduction\n\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.",

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

不能简单认为打浆转数越高纤维素结晶度就越低；关于PFI打浆对纤维素结晶度的影响，文献中存在不同结论。 [4] [5]
有研究认为PFI打浆会使玉米秸秆或软木浆的结晶度下降，但也有研究报道结晶度会升高。 [4]
对于硬木漂白硫酸盐浆纤维或未漂桉木纤维，结晶度随打浆程度先升高后降低。 [5]
还有研究报道烟草茎机械浆的结晶度随PFI打浆先波动上升再下降并重复波动，未确定清晰趋势。 [5]
在该研究的PFI打浆过程中，结晶度、微晶尺寸和各类氢键含量总体变化不大，说明PFI打浆对超分子结构的破坏相对较小。 [3]
该研究同时指出结晶指数、微晶尺寸和氢键含量会随打浆发生变化，且分子间O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量与结晶指数显著相关。 [1]

DSH归档对照

DSH

不完全是：本文的 XRD 结果表明，软木浆和硬木浆的结晶度指数（CI-XI 与 CI-XA）随 PFI 打浆转数都呈“先下降、再上升、随后再下降”的变化，而不是随转数单调降低。[1]
从 0 r 到 16,000 r 的整个过程看，结晶度总体仍为净下降：软木浆的 CI-XI 和 CI-XA 分别降低 4.66% 和 15.47%，硬木浆分别降低 2.65% 和 19.4%。[2]
局部甚至出现转数升高而结晶度上升：软木浆的 CI-XI 由 4,000 r 的 70.42% 升至 8,000 r 的 72.54%，CI-XA 由 37.71% 升至 39.65%；硬木浆的 CI-XI 由 4,000 r 的 73.01% 升至 8,000 r 的 75.06%，CI-XA 由 36.26% 升至 42.35%。[3][4][5][6]
作者对此的解释是：打浆初期结晶度下降说明机械作用主要发生在结晶区；随后升高可能是无定形区在 PFI 打浆的机械与热作用下、干燥时发生共结晶；再下降则可能是结晶区被持续破坏。[7]
前人报道也不一致：有研究认为 PFI 打浆使玉米秸秆或软木浆的结晶度下降，也有报道称硬木漂白硫酸盐浆或未漂桉木纤维先升高后降低；作者指出以往研究并未识别出明确趋势，只观察到结晶度在打浆过程中发生变化。[8][9][10]
作者的总体判断是：结晶度、微晶尺寸和各类氢键含量总体上变化不大，PFI 打浆是相对温和的机械处理，对超分子结构的破坏较小。[11][12][13]
需要注意适用范围：本文实验为漂白软木浆与硬木浆在 0–16,000 r 下的 PFI 打浆，因此“转数越高结晶度越低”既不符合其逐点数据，也不能直接外推到其他浆种或其他打浆条件。[14]

luna：要点100.00%；事实7/7；引用14/14；引用组6/7；边界2/2。

Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.",

The rheological analysis of wet sheets, the tensile strength of dry sheets, and the ﬁber strength\nfor unreﬁned and reﬁned samples: (a) softwood ﬁbers and (b) hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n3.2. Eﬀect of PFI Reﬁning on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\nThe cellulose polymorph of these two ﬁbers had no change during PFI treatment, which illustrates\nthat the PFI reﬁning is a relatively mild mechanical treatment, as the results of XRD in Online Resource\n(Figures S1 and S2) show. In general, the CI-XI and the CI-XA of softwood ﬁbers showed a reduction\nof 4.66% and 15.47%, respectively, and those of hardwood ﬁbers decreased by 2.65% and 19.4%,\nrespectively, as can be seen in Figure 4 and Table 1. The value of the CI-XI was remarkably higher than\nthe CI-XA, which might be caused by the over-ﬁtting of amorphous contribution in the analysis of\nCI-XA. However, the CI-XI and the CI-XA were correlated signiﬁcantly for both softwood ﬁbers and\nhardwood ﬁbers, with a correlation coeﬃcient of 0.919 (p < 0.05) for softwood ﬁbers and 0.925 (p < 0.05)\nfor hardwood ﬁbers, respectively, which is consistent with the report of Ahvenainen et al. The rheological analysis of wet sheets, the tensile strength of dry sheets, and the ﬁber strength\nfor unreﬁned and reﬁned samples: (a) softwood ﬁbers and (b) hardwood ﬁbers.\n3.2. Eﬀect of PFI Reﬁning on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\nThe cellulose polymorph of these two ﬁbers had no change during PFI treatment, which illustrates\nthat the PFI reﬁning is a relatively mild mechanical treatment, as the results of XRD in Online Resource\n(Figures S1 and S2) show. In general, the CI-XI and the CI-XA of softwood ﬁbers showed a reduction\nof 4.66% and 15.47%, respectively, and those of hardwood ﬁbers decreased by 2.65% and 19.4%,\nrespectively, as can be seen in Figure 4 and Table 1. PyMuPDF结构版81块

PFI打浆过程中结晶度先下降，是因为初始打浆阶段机械处理主要作用于结晶区。 [3]
随后结晶度上升，可解释为更大的作用力作用于无定形区，干燥时在PFI打浆的机械和热作用下可能发生共结晶。 [3]
之后结晶度再次下降，可能是结晶区被持续破坏。 [3]
因此结晶度的波动可能源于PFI打浆机械作用作用于纤维素的不同区域。 [3]
O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量与CI-XI呈相似变化，且结晶区中该氢键含量高于无定形区。 [6]

For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood ﬁber, it increased\nﬁrstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. It might be due to\nthe fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than\nO(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend\nin general. This made cellulose\nmore accessible to water and chemicals. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups,\nwhich makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H···O(6) or O(6)H···O(3′)H-bonds. MinerU原生文本117块

PFI打浆过程中，软木纤维和硬木纤维的CI-XI与CI-XA均呈现相似趋势，即先下降、再上升，随后再次下降。 [1]
这种结晶度波动可能源于PFI打浆的机械作用作用于纤维素的不同区域。 [1]
在第一打浆阶段，CI下降表明机械处理可能主要作用于结晶区。 [1]
随后CI上升可解释为更大的作用力作用于无定形区，并在PFI打浆的机械与热作用下的干燥过程中可能发生共结晶（cocrystallization）。 [1]
之后的CI下降则可能是由于结晶区被持续破坏。 [1]

原固定44块

第一阶段结晶度下降，表明PFI机械处理主要作用于纤维素的结晶区。 [5]
随后结晶度上升，可解释为更大的作用力作用于无定形区，并在PFI打浆的机械和热作用下干燥时可能发生共结晶。 [5]
之后的再次下降可能源于结晶区被持续破坏。 [5]

DSH归档对照

DSH

论文报告的现象是：无论针叶木纤维还是阔叶木纤维，结晶度指数CI（衍射峰强度法CI-XI与峰面积法CI-XA）的变化趋势都相同，即先下降、随后上升、之后又回落（见图4），也就是先降、再升、再降的三段式。[1]
按表1实测值（打浆转数为0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 r）：针叶木CI-XI由73.23%依次为70.42%、72.54%、70.93%、69.82%，CI-XA由40.46%依次为37.71%、39.65%、36.22%、34.20%；阔叶木CI-XI由75.55%依次为73.01%、75.06%、74.57%、73.55%，CI-XA由47.16%依次为36.26%、42.35%、39.21%、38.01%。即4000 r处最低、8000 r处回升成高点，此后单调下降。[2][3]
从整体看仍是净下降：针叶木的CI-XI与CI-XA分别降低4.66%和15.47%，阔叶木分别降低2.65%和19.4%。[4]
对“为什么”的总括解释是：CI的波动源于PFI打浆的机械作用分别施加于纤维素的不同区域（结晶区与无定形区），不同区域在不同阶段被破坏或重组，因而CI先降、再升、再降。[5]
第一段下降（0→4000 r）：初始打浆阶段CI下降，作者据此认为机械处理此时主要作用于结晶区，即结晶区被机械作用破坏。[6]
第二段上升（4000→8000 r）：随后CI的增长被解释为更大的作用力转而作用于无定形区，在PFI打浆的机械与热作用下，干燥过程中可能发生共结晶（cocrystallization），使有序（结晶）结构比例回升。[7]
第三段下降（8000→16,000 r）：此后的回落可能是结晶区被持续破坏所致，即长时间打浆后机械破坏重新占据主导。[8]
与上述分区作用相配套的微观依据是：水分子更容易渗入准晶区中亲水(110)晶面之间的空隙（水合作用），使(110)面承受更多机械作用，因此打浆过程中(110)面出现更多粘附（共结晶）与纤维素链断裂，垂直(110)面的晶粒尺寸也最不稳定。[9]
同时，垂直(200)晶面的晶粒尺寸反而随打浆上升，作者用干燥时(200)面取向排列所引起的链聚并或相邻微纤维的结晶学堆叠来解释，并指出水分子难以渗入使(200)面的断裂（解离）作用较弱；这说明CI的升降与不同晶面（不同区域）受机械作用方式的差异有关。[10]
该波动并非由晶型转变或氢键参数改变引起：两种纤维的纤维素多晶型在PFI处理过程中没有变化；FT-IR结果也显示三种氢键的峰位基本不变，故其氢键能与氢键距离保持不变。[11][12]
CI的波动还与分子间O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量的变化同步：该氢键含量同样先降、再升、后降，并与CI-XI显著相关，Pearson相关系数为针叶木0.912、阔叶木0.889（p<0.05）；作者认为原因是结晶区中O(6)H···O(3′)氢键的含量高于无定形区，所以结晶度的升降会带动该氢键含量同向变化。[13][14][15]
需要区分事实与推断：前述三段式机理在原文中均以“probably”“could be interpreted”“might be”等推测性措辞给出，是基于XRD结晶度与FT-IR氢键结果的解释，论文并未给出针对各阶段主导机制的直接实验验证；且实验只在0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 r五个打浆转数取样，转折点的精确位置不能据此外推到其他转数。[6][7][8][2]

      "id": "C1",
      "text": "论文报告的现象是：无论针叶木纤维还是阔叶木纤维，结晶度指数CI（衍射峰强度法CI-XI与峰面积法CI-XA）的变化趋势都相同，即先下降、随后上升、之后又回落（见图4），也就是先降、再升、再降的三段式。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",

PFI2-014 · 按照作者的解释，PFI打浆为什么会提高WRV，又如何与纤维间结合联系起来？

参考答案与评分要点
打浆促进细纤维化，产生新的表面和更多孔隙，使WRV及纤维膨胀提高；纤维横向更柔顺，有助于改善纤维网络中的纤维间结合。这是本文提出的解释链条，不能据此给出每一步的独立因果效应大小。

PFI打浆使打浆度和WRV随打浆转数增加而显著升高。 [1]
作者解释WRV升高是因为更高程度的细纤维化产生新的表面和更多孔隙。 [1]
以WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，并有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [1]
PFI打浆可引起内部细纤维化，使纤维壁分层、疏松和润胀，并提高纤维的润胀、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力。 [2]

    "text": "polymers\nArticle\nProbing Eﬀect of Papirindustriens Forskningsinstitut\n(PFI) Reﬁning on Aggregation Structure of Cellulose:\nCrystal Packing and Hydrogen-Bonding Network\nKunpeng Li, Lihong Zhao * and Beihai He\nState Key Laboratory of Pulp and Paper Engineering, South China University of Technology, 381 Wushan Rd.,\nTianhe District, Guangzhou 510640, China; felikp@mail.scut.edu.cn (K.L.); ppebhhe@scut.edu.cn (B.H.)\n* Correspondence: zhaolh@scut.edu.cn\nReceived: 17 November 2020; Accepted: 2 December 2020; Published: 4 December 2020\nAbstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that aﬀects the properties of cellulosic\nﬁbers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) reﬁning on the\nmolecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between\nthe crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic ﬁbers. The results showed that\nthe polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost\nunchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed\nwith reﬁning. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds was signiﬁcantly\ncorrelated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson\ncorrelation coeﬃcient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood ﬁbers and 0.889 (p < 0.05)\nfor hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling,\nand ﬁbrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds\nplay an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.\n\nKeywords: natural cellulosic ﬁbers; mechanical reﬁning; Crystallinity; Crystallite size;\nHydrogen bonds\n\n1. Introduction\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired\nphysical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic ﬁbers. Therein,\nPapirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) reﬁning is the most common laboratory reﬁner in order to\nimprove the inter-ﬁber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-ﬁbrillated\nor nano-ﬁbrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main eﬀects of PFI reﬁning on ﬁbers are: (i) internal\nﬁbrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of ﬁber wall; (ii) external ﬁbrillation—peeling of\nﬁbrils from the ﬁber surface while remaining attached; (iii) ﬁber shortening—ﬁber cutting due to\nshearing action, and (iv) ﬁnes formation—primary ﬁnes come from ray cells and parenchyma cells\nand microﬁbrils that are caused by ﬁber shortening or external ﬁbrillation. Moreover, the PFI reﬁning\ncould be adopted to obtain a higher internal ﬁbrillation than other laboratory reﬁners [1]. These eﬀects\nof the PFI reﬁning on cellulosic ﬁbers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the ﬂexibility, and the\ninter-ﬁber bonding capacity of ﬁbers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and\nproperties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during reﬁning [7,8].\n\nThere are some diﬀerent conclusions regarding to the eﬀects of PFI reﬁning on crystallinity of\ncellulose, not like that of ball milling, which eﬀectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment\nprogresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI reﬁning\nfor corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased\nPolymers 2020, 12, 2912; doi:10.3390/polym12122912 www.mdpi.com/journal/polymers",

随着PFI打浆转数增加，打浆度和WRV均显著提高。 [1]
作者解释，这是因为更高程度的纤维化产生了新的表面和更多孔隙。 [1]
PFI打浆的主要作用包括内部纤维化，即纤维壁的分层、松散和润胀，以及外部纤维化等，这些作用会提高纤维的可及性、润胀、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力。 [2]
纤维素分子间氢键断裂会导致更广泛的分层和更高的比表面积，使纤维素更易接触水和化学试剂。 [5]
WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [1]

    "page_end": 1,
    "text": "1. Introduction\n\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.",

    "text": "As to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.\n\n3.4. Correlation between CI and Content of Inter-Molecular H-Bonds during PFI Refining\n\nSimilar to the CI-XI, the content of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds decreased first and then had an increase, followed by a decline for the two fibers (as shown in Figure 8a,b). Besides, the Pearson correlation coeficients were calculated between the content of H-bonds and the CI-XI. It was 0.912 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 $( p < 0 . 0 5 )$ for hardwood fibers, respectively. 原固定44块

PFI打浆转数增加时，打浆度和WRV显著升高。 [1]
作者将WRV升高归因于更高程度的细纤维化产生了新表面和更多孔隙。 [1]
以WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [1]
纤维形态分析和WRV结果还表明，细纤维化以及纤丝之间的分离随打浆过程增加。 [1]
PFI打浆的主要作用包括内部细纤维化，即纤维壁分层、疏松和润胀，并改善纤维的柔顺性和纤维间结合能力。 [3]

DSH归档对照

DSH

按作者的解释，PFI打浆使打浆度和WRV随打浆转数显著升高；作者把原因归结为更高程度的纤丝化（fibrillation）产生了新的表面和更多孔隙，使纤维能保留更多水。[1]
作者进一步把这种以WRV表征的润胀增加与纤维间结合联系起来：润胀使纤维在横向上更柔顺（more compliant in transverse），从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。[2]
纤维形态分析与WRV结果共同表明，纤丝化以及纤丝之间的分离随打浆过程而增加。[3]
这与引言中的总体判断一致：PFI打浆的主要作用之一是内部纤丝化，即纤维壁的分层、松散和润胀；这些作用会提高纤维的可及性、润胀、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力。[4][5]
在片材力学性能上，作者把抗张强度的增加主要归因于PFI打浆过程中纤丝化和细小组分（fines）的增加，并总结说PFI打浆提高了纤丝化程度（尤其是内部纤丝化）、纤维润胀和片材抗张强度，而未降低纤维本身的抗张强度。[6][7]
作者在讨论氢键变化时还提到超分子层面的关联：分子间氢键减少和结晶度降低会进一步提高纤维素纤维的柔顺性，文中把分子链运动性提高、可及性和WRV并列为相关因素。[8]
需要区分证据来源：上述“新表面和更多孔隙”的定量数据在Online Resource的Table S1中，而本PDF并未附带该补充材料。[1]
从本文报告的方法与结果看，没有给出单根纤维间结合强度的直接测量值；“改善纤维间结合”是作者基于WRV/横向柔顺性和片材抗张强度作出的解释，而非直接测得的结合强度。

luna：要点100.00%；事实8/8；引用9/9；引用组7/8；边界2/2。

针叶木和阔叶木在PFI打浆后纤维长度总体均呈下降趋势，但两者变化并不相同。 [1]
针叶木纤维长度变化显著，而阔叶木纤维长度没有相对针叶木那样的显著变化。 [1]
这种差别可能是因为阔叶木打浆时施加的refining pressure较低。 [1]
文中PFI打浆条件给出每齿长作用力为针叶木3.33 N/mm、阔叶木1.77 N/mm。 [7]

    "text": "3. Results and Discussions\n\n3.1. The Morphological Analysis, Swelling, and Mechanical Properties\nFor softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, the macro-ﬁbrillation index and the ﬁber length had\na downward trend, and the ﬁnes content has an upward trend for the softwood ﬁbers during PFI\nreﬁning, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-ﬁbrillation index and ﬁber length of softwood ﬁbers\nchanged signiﬁcantly. However, two parameters of hardwood ﬁbers had no signiﬁcant variations\nrelative to softwood ﬁbers. It might be because of the lower reﬁning pressure that was applied in\nhardwood ﬁbers. The macro-ﬁbrillation index characterizes external macro-ﬁbrillation. The results of\nﬁber morphology analysis showed that external ﬁbrillation increased with the reﬁning process. It is\nconsistent with the increasing speciﬁc surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource).\n\nFigure 1. The morphological analysis for the unreﬁned and reﬁned samples: (a) softwood ﬁbers and\n(b) hardwood ﬁbers.\nThe beating degree and the WRV had a signiﬁcant increment with increasing PFI reﬁning\nrevolutions, as can be seen in Figure 2. It is caused by the higher ﬁbrillation that produces the\nnew surface and more pores (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource). The increase in swelling\ncharacterized by WRV makes the ﬁbers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to\nimproving the inter-ﬁber bonding strength of the ﬁber network. The results of ﬁber morphology\nanalysis and water retention value showing that the ﬁbrillation and the separation between ﬁbrils\nincrease with the reﬁning process.",
    "verification": {
      "status": "frozen_chunk_metadata_verified"
    }
  },
  {
    "ref": "[7]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Reﬁning\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp ﬁbers were obtained from\nZhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI reﬁner\n(Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency\nof 10%, the gap between the opposite reﬁning plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were\n3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp\nﬁbers were separately reﬁned in a PFI reﬁner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and\nat 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an\nincreasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood ﬁbers and 0,\n26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\nThe ﬁnes content, weighted mean length, and macro-ﬁbrillation index of each sample were\ndetermined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of\ndry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT\n12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus\n(Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361.",

      "status": "frozen_chunk_metadata_verified"
    }
  }

针叶木和阔叶木打浆后纤维长度均呈下降趋势。 [2]
针叶木的纤维长度变化显著，而阔叶木的宏观纤维化指数和纤维长度相对针叶木无显著变化。 [2]
这种差别可能是因为阔叶木打浆时施加的 refining pressure 较低。 [2]
实验条件中针叶木和阔叶木的单位刀长作用力分别为 3.33 N/mm 和 1.77 N/mm。 [3]

原固定44块

PFI打浆中针叶木和阔叶木纤维长度均呈下降趋势，但针叶木的纤维长度变化显著，阔叶木相对针叶木没有显著变化。 [1]
文献将阔叶木纤维长度等参数变化不显著归因于其打浆时施加的压力较低。 [1]
方法部分显示针叶木和阔叶木的每杆长作用力分别为3.33 N/mm和1.77 N/mm，说明两者打浆强度不同。 [6]

DSH归档对照

DSH

不一样：针叶木浆和阔叶木浆打浆后纤维长度虽然都呈下降趋势，但下降的幅度和显著性差别很大。 [1]
针叶木浆的宏观细纤维化指数（macro-fibrillation index）和纤维长度在PFI打浆中变化显著。 [2]
阔叶木浆的宏观细纤维化指数和纤维长度这两项参数相对针叶木没有显著变化。 [3]
按图1左纵轴刻度读取的近似值（非正文数字）：针叶木平均长度加权纤维长度由0转的约2.03 mm降到16 000转的约1.66 mm，降幅约18%；阔叶木在0至16 000转之间约为0.86–0.90 mm，相对变化不超过约3%。 [4]
文中的纤维长度以MORFI LB分析仪测得的加权平均长度（weighted mean length）表示，同一仪器同时测定细小组分和宏观细纤维化指数。 [5]
两种浆的打浆转数序列相同，均为0、4000、8000、12 000和16 000转。 [6]
但两者所受的打浆作用力不同：每齿刀长的作用力针叶木为3.33 N/mm、阔叶木为1.77 N/mm，约为前者的0.53倍。 [7]
论文给出的差别原因是施加于阔叶木的打浆压力较低；原文用“might be”表述，属推测性解释。 [8]
机理上，PFI打浆引起的“纤维缩短”指剪切作用造成的纤维切断。 [9]
据此推断（论文未直接证实）：阔叶木作用力约为针叶木的一半，剪切切断作用更弱，纤维长度几乎不降；针叶木作用力更高，切断更多，长度下降更明显。 [7][9]
另一个可能的因素（同样属推断，论文未据此归因）：针叶木初始纤维本身更长（图1中约2.0 mm，阔叶木约0.9 mm），在相同打浆条件下更易被切断缩短。 [4]
伴随的形态变化是：外加细纤维化随打浆进行而增加，针叶木的细小组分呈上升趋势，而论文把细小组分与纤维缩短或外部细纤维化联系在一起。 [12][11][10]
差别带来的后果：针叶木湿纸幅强度的提高比阔叶木更明显，因为纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起关键作用。 [13][14]
证据边界：论文只用一句话把阔叶木的“无显著变化”推测为打浆压力较低，没有给出纤维长度与打浆压力或转数的定量关系，也没有定量区分纤维切断与外部细纤维化的贡献，因此更细的原因无法由本文确定。

The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },

      "text": "证据边界：论文只用一句话把阔叶木的“无显著变化”推测为打浆压力较低，没有给出纤维长度与打浆压力或转数的定量关系，也没有定量区分纤维切断与外部细纤维化的贡献，因此更细的原因无法由本文确定。",

      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "For softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, the macro-fibrillation index and the fiber length had a downward trend, and the fines content has an upward trend for the softwood fibers during PFI refining, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-fibrillation index and fiber length of softwood fibers changed significantly. However, two parameters of hardwood fibers had no significant variations relative to softwood fibers. It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. It is consistent with the increasing specific surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource)."
      }

PFI2-016 · 为什么本文认为纸张抗张性能提高，并不意味着单根纤维本身的强度也一定提高？零距抗张在这里有什么用？

参考答案与评分要点
作者将纸张抗张性能改善主要联系到细纤维化、细小纤维及纤维间结合。零距抗张指数用于表征纤维本身的抗张强度，结果表明本文PFI处理没有降低纤维强度。因此应区分纸页网络性能和纤维本身强度，不能只凭纸张变强推断单根纤维必然变强。

PyMuPDF结构版81块

本文认为纸张抗张强度的提高主要来自PFI精磨过程中不断增强的细纤维化和细组分（fines）。 [1]
零距抗张指数通常用于表征纤维本身的抗张强度。 [1]
零距抗张结果表明PFI精磨没有降低纤维强度，这与Kouko等的报道一致。 [1]
因此，PFI精磨提高了细纤维化、纤维润胀和纸页抗张强度，同时未出现纤维抗张强度下降，但这不等同于单根纤维强度一定提高。 [1]

MinerU原生文本117块

本文把纸张抗张指数的提高主要归因于PFI精磨过程中的细纤维化和细小纤维增加，而不是单根纤维强度本身提高。 [1]
零距抗张指数通常用于表征纤维的拉伸强度。 [1]
零距抗张结果显示，PFI精磨没有降低纤维强度，这与Kouko等的报道一致。 [1]
精磨可提高纤维润胀、细纤维化和纸页抗张强度，同时在零距抗张上不出现纤维强度下降；因此纸页抗张提高不能据此推出单根纤维强度一定提高。 [1]

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

本文把纸页抗张强度提高主要归因于PFI精磨过程中细纤维化（尤其是内部细纤维化）和细组分的增加。 [1]
精磨提高打浆度和WRV、促进纤维润胀并使其更柔顺，从而改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度，这也会提升纸页抗张性能。 [5]
零距抗张指数通常用于表征纤维的拉伸强度，该文用其结果表明PFI精磨没有降低纤维强度。 [1]

DSH归档对照

DSH

本文把纸页强度与纤维强度作为两个层次分别测量：干纸页抗张强度按 TAPPI T494、湿纸幅强度按 GB/T 12914-2008 测定，零距抗张强度则用 Z-Span 2400 按 ISO 15361 测定。 [1]
图 3 把抗张指数、零距抗张指数和湿纸幅强度一并表示为打浆转数的函数，从中可以看到纸页抗张指数随 PFI 打浆明显上升。 [2]
作者把纸页抗张强度的增量主要归因于打浆过程中不断增多的细纤维化（fibrillation）和细小纤维（fines），而不是纤维本身强度的变化。 [3]
其原因在于打浆使纤维润胀（WRV 增大）、横向更柔顺，从而提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度，即纸页强度在很大程度上来自纤维之间的结合。 [4]
而且 PFI 打浆本身还包含纤维切断（fiber shortening，剪切作用使纤维变短），因此纸页强度上升不能简单理解为纤维变长或变强（推断）。 [5]
零距抗张的作用正是表征纤维自身的抗张强度：文中明确说明零距抗张指数通常用于表征纤维的抗张强度。 [6]
零距抗张的实测结果显示，PFI 打浆没有降低纤维强度，与 Kouko 等的报道一致；也就是说论文只支持“纤维强度未下降”，并没有给出纤维强度随纸页强度同步提高的证据。 [7]
作者的总结是：PFI 打浆提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内部细纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页抗张强度，同时纤维抗张强度没有下降。 [8]
因此，零距抗张在这里起的是把“纤维自身强度”单独拎出来检验的作用：只要它没有下降，纸页强度的提高就可以归因于纤维间结合改善，而不必假设单根纤维强度提高（推断）。 [6][7]
需要注意的是，本文并未直接测量单根纤维的拉伸强度，零距抗张仍是纸页尺度的间接表征，所以“纤维强度未降低”不能等同于“单根纤维强度提高”（推断）。 [1][6]

        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "o improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [ 1 ] and accessibility [ 2 , 3 ], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [ 4 , 5 , 6 ]. The main effects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [ 1 ]. These effects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.   "claim_assessments": [
    {
      "id": "C1",
      "text": "与硬木浆相比，软木浆（softwood fiber）的湿纸幅强度（wet-web strength）增幅更明显。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },

DSH归档对照

DSH

本文比较的是商品漂白硫酸盐针叶木浆（softwood）与阔叶木浆（hardwood）[1]。
图3把抗张指数、零抗张指数和湿纸幅强度表示为PFI磨浆转数的函数，用于对比这两类浆[2]。
结果表明，针叶木浆的湿纸幅强度增幅比阔叶木浆更明显[3]。
作者对此的解释是：纤维长度在湿纸幅强度中起关键作用[4]。
同一段还指出，抗张强度的提高主要归因于PFI磨浆过程中不断增加的分丝帚化和细小纤维[5]。
零抗张指数结果表明，PFI磨浆并未降低单根纤维的强度[6]。
除“纤维长度起关键作用”外，文中没有对该差异给出更进一步的定量解释或机理分析。

PFI2-018 · 这篇论文如何从FT-IR获得不同氢键的相对含量？请说明拟合波段、函数和含量口径。

参考答案与评分要点
先归一化并用二阶导数辅助确定峰位；对3000–3700 cm⁻¹羟基区域采用高斯函数非线性拟合，软件为Peakfit 4.12；各组分相对含量按峰面积占比计算，不能当作绝对氢键数量。

PyMuPDF结构版81块

论文将3000–3700 cm−1的羟基吸收带解卷积为四个主要子峰，并依据各子峰的面积占比分别计算不同氢键的相对含量。 [2] [3]
拟合前光谱在1016 cm−1归一化，并用Savitzky–Golay算法获得导数曲线；各氢键组分的峰位取自二阶导数谱，并按不同氢键归属区确定。 [3]
对3000–3700 cm−1区间采用Gaussian函数，在Peakfit 4.12软件中进行非线性拟合。 [3]
各氢键的归属区间为：3580–3550 cm−1对应free OH(2)和OH(6)，3455–3410 cm−1对应O(2)H···O(6)分子内氢键，3375–3340 cm−1对应O(3)H···O(5)分子内氢键，3310–3230 cm−1对应O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键（cellulose I）。 [6]
文中还给出约3227、3346、3452 cm−1分别对应O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键、O(3)H···O(5)分子内氢键和O(2)H···O(6)分子内氢键。 [2]

FT-IR谱在1016 cm−1处归一化，并用Savitzky–Golay算法获得导数曲线，以便从二阶导数谱确定各氢键组分的峰位。 [3]
拟合波段为3000–3700 cm−1，采用Gaussian函数，在Peakfit 4.12软件中进行非线性拟合。 [3]
论文将3000–3700 cm−1的羟基谱带去卷积为四个主要谱带，并依据峰位指认不同氢键类型。 [7]
不同氢键的相对含量按对应拟合谱带的面积比例计算。 [7]
指认的峰位包括O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键约3227 cm−1、O(3)H···O(5)分子内氢键约3346 cm−1和O(2)H···O(6)分子内氢键约3452 cm−1。 [7]
分析中还讨论了free OH(2)和OH(6)的相对含量变化。 [6]

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

拟合波段为 3000–3700 cm−1 的羟基伸缩振动区。 [3]
拟合前光谱在 1016 cm−1 归一化，并用 Savitzky–Golay 算法获得导数曲线。 [3]
各氢键组分的峰位取自二阶导数谱，并按不同氢键的归属区域确定。 [3]
非线性拟合采用 Gaussian 函数，在 PeakFit 4.12 软件中完成。 [3]
羟基带被解卷积为四个主要子峰，峰位依据上述峰位确定。 [6]
不同氢键的相对含量按各子峰面积占该带解卷积总面积的比例计算。 [6]
结果表中列出的组分包括 Free OH(2) 和 OH(6)、O(6)H···O(3′)、O(3)H···O(5)、O(2)H···O(6)，并给出 r2。 [6]

DSH归档对照

DSH

论文对 FT-IR 的羟基（O–H）伸缩振动谱带做分峰（去卷积）：把 3000–3700 cm−1 的羟基谱带分解为四个主要谱带，再以各谱带的面积比例（area proportion）计算不同氢键的相对含量（relative content）。
确定峰位前的处理是：光谱在 1016 cm−1 处归一化，并用 Savitzky–Golay 算法求导；各氢键组分的波数取自二阶导数谱，按已归属给不同氢键的波数区间读取。
拟合波段为 3000–3700 cm−1，与上述羟基谱带范围一致。
拟合函数为 Gaussian（高斯）函数，采用非线性拟合，软件为 Peakfit 4.12（SeaSolve Software Inc., Framingham, MA, USA）。
去卷积得到四个主要谱带，即三种氢键（O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间、O(3)H···O(5) 分子内、O(2)H···O(6) 分子内）加一个游离 OH(2) 与 OH(6) 的合并谱带；表 2 的标题写明为“三种氢键与游离 OH 的相对含量”。
各谱带的归属区间为：3580–3550 cm−1 对应游离 OH(2) 与 OH(6)；3455–3410 cm−1 对应 O(2)H···O(6) 分子内氢键；3375–3340 cm−1 对应 O(3)H···O(5) 分子内氢键；3310–3230 cm−1 对应 cellulose I 中的 O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键。
实际拟合得到的谱带中心约在 3227 cm−1（O(6)H···O(3′)）、3346 cm−1（O(3)H···O(5)）、3452 cm−1（O(2)H···O(6)），在整个精磨过程中基本不变。
含量口径是“峰面积占比”：以每个高斯分峰的面积除以四个分峰面积之和（即 3000–3700 cm−1 拟合区的总拟合面积，记为 100%），每个样品谱单独归一——表 2 每个精磨次数一行，四种组分（三种氢键 + 游离 OH）四列数值逐行合计恰为 100.00（如 0 r：28.23+28.44+31.40+11.93=100.00），可见该“面积比例”就是以四个分峰总面积为 100% 的百分比（此归一方式由表中数值核对得出，属推断；原文仅表述为“area proportion of the band”），故三种氢键各自都小于 100%，其余份额归游离 OH。
峰位与含量属两条不同口径：峰位按式(4)、式(5)（Pimentel–Sederholm 关系）用于计算氢键能与氢键距离 R，论文据此得出三种氢键的能量与距离基本不变；相对含量则只由分峰面积给出，不涉及能量或键长。
表 2 末列另给出 r2（软木浆 0.9995–0.9996，硬木浆 0.9989–0.9992），正文未解释 r2 的定义与计算方式。
论文未说明 Savitzky–Golay 求导所用的窗口点数与多项式阶数，也未说明 FT-IR 谱是否做基线校正；全文未见吸收系数或摩尔吸光率校正的说明，因此“面积占比”能否直接换算为氢键的绝对含量，仅凭该文无法确定。
以软木浆为例，O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键的相对含量从 0 r 的 28.23% 变为 16,000 r 的 23.56%（全程下降 16.54%，Table 2a）。

luna：要点100.00%；事实12/12；引用22/22；引用组8/12；边界2/2。

      "id": "C1",
      "text": "论文对 FT-IR 的羟基（O–H）伸缩振动谱带做分峰（去卷积）：把 3000–3700 cm−1 的羟基谱带分解为四个主要谱带，再以各谱带的面积比例（area proportion）计算不同氢键的相对含量（relative content）。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E16",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The band of hydroxyl groups (3000–3700 cm−1) was deconvoluted into four predominant bands in the present study based on the peak positions above. Subsequently, the relative content of various H-bonds was calculated based on area proportion of the band, respectively."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C2",
      "text": "确定峰位前的处理是：光谱在 1016 cm−1 处归一化，并用 Savitzky–Golay 算法求导；各氢键组分的波数取自二阶导数谱，按已归属给不同氢键的波数区间读取。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E15",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The spectral was normalized at 1016 cm−1 and the derivative curve was obtained by applying the Savitzky–Golay algorithm. The wavenumbers of H-bonding components are taken from second-derivative spectra according to regions that are assigned to various H-bonds. Nonlinear fitting of the FT-IR spectral region from 3000 cm−1 to 3700 cm−1 was carried out with Gaussian function in Peakfit 4.12 software (SeaSolve Software Inc., Framingham, MA, USA). The Pearson correlation coefficients were evaluated between the CI and content of various H-bonds, with a statistically significant p-value of <0.05, while using Spss 25.0 statistics software (IBM Corp., Armonk, NY, USA)."

The Morphological Analysis, Swelling, and Mechanical Properties For softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, the macro-fibrillation index and the fiber length had a downward trend, and the fines content has an upward trend for the softwood fibers during PFI refining, as can be seen in Figure 1 . The macro-fibrillation index and fiber length of softwood fibers changed significantly. However, two parameters of hardwood fibers had no significant variations relative to softwood fibers. It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in ",

PFI2-019 · O(6)H···O(3′)、O(3)H···O(5)、O(2)H···O(6)这三种氢键的红外峰大概在多少波数？

参考答案与评分要点
正文描述的约值依次为3227、3346、3452 cm⁻¹。O(6)H···O(3′)为分子间氢键，另外两类为分子内氢键；这些是正文约值。

DSH归档对照

DSH

在纤维素纤维的 FT-IR 谱中，论文给出的三种氢键红外峰大约为：O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键约 3227 cm⁻¹，O(3)H···O(5) 分子内氢键约 3346 cm⁻¹，O(2)H···O(6) 分子内氢键约 3452 cm⁻¹。
论文同时列出这三类氢键在纤维素 I 中的常规归属区间：O(2)H···O(6) 为 3455–3410 cm⁻¹，O(3)H···O(5) 为 3375–3340 cm⁻¹，O(6)H···O(3′) 为 3310–3230 cm⁻¹；作为对照，3580–3550 cm⁻¹ 归属自由的 OH(2) 和 OH(6)。
这些峰位取自 FT-IR 二阶导数谱：论文按各氢键对应的归属区间，从二阶导数谱读取其波数。
拟合所用的光谱区间为 3000–3700 cm⁻¹，采用高斯函数进行非线性拟合。
在 PFI 精磨全过程中，软木纤维和硬木纤维的这三个峰位几乎保持不变（见图 6a,b）。
由于峰位几乎没有红移或蓝移，按式 (4)、(5) 得到的三种氢键的氢键能与氢键距离也保持不变。
论文对这三个峰位只以 “around（约）” 给出，未给出更精确的单一数值或误差范围，因此应理解为约值。

PFI2-020 · 论文说打浆后氢键能量和距离基本不变，那是不是说明打浆对氢键网络基本没影响？

参考答案与评分要点
不表示完全不变。本文三类氢键的峰位几乎不变，因此据公式推得能量和距离基本不变；但相对含量仍变化：0到16000转，针叶木分子间氢键由28.23%变为23.56%，阔叶木由26.55%变为24.98%。应区分单类氢键能量/距离与不同组分的相对分布。

PyMuPDF结构版81块

论文观察到软木和硬木纤维中三类氢键的峰位在整个打浆过程中几乎保持不变，因此氢键能量和氢键距离基本不变。 [1]
同一研究的摘要指出，打浆后晶型、氢键距离和各类氢键的能量几乎不变，但结晶指数、微晶尺寸和不同氢键的含量随打浆发生变化。 [7]
所以不能由氢键能量和距离基本不变推出打浆对氢键网络基本没影响；该结果只反映局部氢键参数稳定，而不同氢键的含量和网络组成仍可能改变。 [1] [7]

luna：要点100.00%；事实3/3；引用4/4；引用组3/3；边界2/2。

论文的结果是：在PFI打浆全过程中，O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键、O(3)H···O(5)与O(2)H···O(6)分子内氢键的峰位几乎保持不变，因而由峰位计算的氢键能量和氢键距离也基本不变。 [1]
但同一研究指出，在氢键距离和能量几乎不变的同时，结晶指数、微晶尺寸以及各类氢键的含量会随打浆发生变化。 [3]
其中，分子间O(6)H···O(3′)氢键的含量与XRD得到的结晶指数显著相关，Pearson相关系数为软木纤维0.888（p < 0.05）、硬木纤维0.889（p < 0.05）。 [3]
因此，不能据此认为打浆对氢键网络基本没影响；更准确的表述是氢键的能量和距离等参数基本稳定，而氢键含量/数量及其与结晶区堆积相关的网络组织发生了改变。 [1] [3]

It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.\n\nKeywords: natural cellulosic fibers; mechanical refining; Crystallinity; Crystallite size; Hydrogen bonds",

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

论文报告PFI打浆后三类氢键的峰位几乎不变，因此按公式计算的氢键能量和氢键距离基本不变。 [2]
但论文同时指出，打浆过程中结晶指数、微晶尺寸以及各类氢键的含量会发生变化。 [4] [5]
其中分子间O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量与结晶指数显著相关，软木纤维的Pearson相关系数为0.888，硬木纤维为0.889。 [5]
论文认为可及性、润胀和纤丝化等变化与超分子结构密切相关，分子间氢键在纤维素晶体堆叠中起重要作用。 [5]
