DSH归档对照

DSH

不能这样推论。论文并没有说打浆对氢键网络“没有影响”，它把结论分成两类量：晶型、氢键距离与氢键能量“几乎不变”，而晶度指数、微晶尺寸以及各类氢键的“含量”随打浆发生了变化。 [1]
“能量和距离不变”的直接依据是峰位不变：三种氢键的峰位——O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键约 3227 cm−1、O(3)H···O(5) 约 3346 cm−1、O(2)H···O(6) 约 3452 cm−1——在整个打浆过程中几乎保持常数，未出现明显红移或蓝移，代入式(4)、(5)后三种氢键的键能与键距“保持不变”，作者并把它与“晶型未变”并列。 [2][3][4]
但同文的“含量”数据说明氢键网络组成确有变化：软木浆 O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键的相对含量（%）在 0/4000/8000/12,000/16,000 r 依次为 28.23、26.05、28.43、26.68、23.56，文中给出的 −7.72、+9.14、−17.13 与总降幅 16.54 均按相对变化计（28.23→23.56 约 −16.5%，此核算由本回答按文中数值完成）。 [5][6]
硬木浆 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键总体下降 5.91（26.55→24.98，相对变化），而分子内 O(3)H···O(5) 氢键反而增加：软木 +22.78（28.44→34.92）、硬木 +8.8（29.09→31.65），与分子间氢键的方向相反。 [6][7]
O(2)H···O(6) 分子内氢键同样不是恒定值：软木在 0→4000 r 由 31.4 升至 32.5（+3.5），4000→12,000 r 下降 21.57，最后一个阶段又升高 15.26；作者概括说两种浆的该氢键“除 0→4000 r 阶段外均下降”。 [8][9]
“键能/键距不变”与“网络变化”可以并存：含量是 FT-IR 羟基谱带分峰后按峰面积占比得到的相对含量，键能与键距则由峰位代入经验公式(4)、(5)推算；峰位不动只说明单个氢键的强度与几何未变，而各组分占比变化说明氢键在断裂与形成之间重新分配（原文明确指出既有 breakage 也有 formation）。 [10][11]
论文进一步把氢键含量与晶体堆积联系起来：O(6)H···O(3′) 含量与 CI-XI 显著正相关，3.4 节给出软木 0.912、硬木 0.889（p < 0.05），摘要则给出 0.888（软木）与 0.889（硬木）；两处软木数值不一致，属原文内部不一致，引用时须按具体位置区分。 [12][13]
晶度本身也随打浆改变：软木的 CI-XI、CI-XA 分别降低 4.66 与 15.47，硬木降低 2.65 与 19.4；按表 1 数值核算这些亦为相对变化（如 73.23→69.82 约 −4.66%）。 [14]
作者自己的措辞比较克制：结论写“crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general”，并把 PFI 打浆称为对超分子结构“破坏相对较小”的打浆方式，但结论开篇同时明确 PFI 打浆也作用于超分子结构（微晶尺寸、晶度、各类氢键含量）。因此准确说法是“总体变化幅度温和”，而不是“没有影响”。 [15][16][17]
所以回答应分情况：若“没影响”指单个氢键的键能、键距以及纤维素晶型，论文数据支持“基本不变”；若指氢键网络的组成与比例、以及它与晶度的关联，则论文数据表明打浆有明显影响（相对含量变化可达 20% 量级），作者也把这些变化与可及度、润胀、分丝帚化联系起来。 [1][7]
论文只给出相对含量和由峰位经验公式推算的键能/键距，没有给出氢键的绝对数量、网络连通性或空间拓扑，因此“打浆是否改变了氢键网络的拓扑结构”超出本文证据范围，只能作推断。 [10]

For the content of the O(2)H⋯O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H⋯O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H⋯O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H⋯O(5) H-bonds. As to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in ",
        "document_id": "doc_0fcf2a50cfa02d21",
        "start": 23000,
        "end": 24000

    {
      "id": "C6",
      "text": "“键能/键距不变”与“网络变化”可以并存：含量是 FT-IR 羟基谱带分峰后按峰面积占比得到的相对含量，键能与键距则由峰位代入经验公式(4)、(5)推算；峰位不动只说明单个氢键的强度与几何未变，而各组分占比变化说明氢键在断裂与形成之间重新分配（原文明确指出既有 breakage 也有 formation）。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "B050",
      "basis": {
        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "O(3′) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, the trend was almost similar to that of softwood fibers, except for a small increase of 0.45% from 8000 r to 12,000 r (in Table 2 b). On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H⋯O(3′) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1 ). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H⋯O(3′) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1 ). As to the O(3)H⋯O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of",

        "text": ", which illustrates that the PFI refining is a relatively mild mechanical treatment, as the results of XRD in Online Resource ( Figures S1 and S2 ) show. However, the CI-XI and the CI-XA were correlated significantly for both softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, with a correlation coefficient of 0.919 ( p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.925 ( p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively, which is consistent with the report of Ahvenainen et al.         "text": "cense ( http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ ). Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that affects the properties of cellulosic fibers.   "reasons": {
    "basis_C1": "摘要直接区分了基本不变的晶型、氢键距离和能量，以及随打浆变化的晶度、微晶尺寸和氢键含量。",
    "basis_C10": "摘要概括了能量、距离与晶型基本不变，而氢键含量等指标随打浆改变。",
    "basis_C11": "所给材料定义了相对含量并说明能量和距离的估算，但没有单一段落直接确立拓扑信息缺失这一证据边界。",
    "basis_C2": "该段列出三类氢键峰位近乎恒定，并说明据公式推得的能量和距离不变。",
    "basis_C3": "表中直接给出针叶木各转数下氢键相对含量，可核对所列数值。",
    "basis_C4": "阔叶木含量表列出 O(6)H···O(3′) 与 O(3)H···O(5) 各转数的相对含量。",
    "basis_C5": "正文直接报告 O(2)H···O(6) 氢键含量的阶段性升降及两类纤维的总体趋势。",
    "basis_C6": "正文将氢键含量变化与氢键断裂、形成并存联系起来。",
    "basis_C7": "正文相关分析给出 CI-XI 与氢键含量的相关系数及显著性。",
    "basis_C8": "正文报告两种纤维 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 的打浆后降幅。",
    "basis_C9": "结论称相关指标总体变化不大，并将 PFI 打浆描述为对超分子结构破坏较小。",
    "boundary": "回答区分了能量距离与组分含量，给出可回答的数值，并明确网络拓扑超出论文证据范围。",

阔叶木的 O(3)H···O(5) 分子内氢键相对含量在 4000 r 时为 33.06%，在 12000 r 时为 29.28%。 [3]
从 4000 r 到 12000 r，该相对含量变化为 29.28% − 33.06% = −3.78 个百分点，即下降 3.78 个百分点。 [3]
以 4000 r 的 33.06% 为基准，相对变化为 (−3.78 / 33.06) × 100% ≈ −11.43%，即相对下降约 11.43%。 [3]

DSH归档对照

DSH

论文表2b（阔叶木纤维）列出O(3)H···O(5)分子内氢键的相对含量：4000转为33.06%，12,000转为29.28%。 [1][2][3][4]
这些数值是相对含量（%）：将3000–3700 cm−1的羟基谱带去卷积为四个子带后，按各子带面积比例计算，因此两个数值之差应以百分点表示。 [5][6]
从4000转到12,000转，阔叶木O(3)H···O(5)氢键的相对含量下降了3.78个百分点（33.06% − 29.28% = 3.78个百分点）。 [3][4]
以4000转的33.06%为基准，相对变化为(29.28% − 33.06%)/33.06% × 100% ≈ −11.43%，即相对减少约11.4%。 [3][4]
需要说明的是，论文正文没有直接给出4000至12,000转这一区间阔叶木O(3)H···O(5)含量的变化数值，正文只说明其趋势为先升高、后下降、再上升，并给出全流程（0至16,000转）的相对变化为增加8.8%；上述百分点和相对变化均由表2b的数值计算得到。 [7][8]

luna：要点100.00%；事实5/5；引用12/12；引用组4/5；边界2/2。

DSH归档对照

DSH

针叶木浆（漂白硫酸盐针叶木浆）经PFI打浆至16000转时，四项指标可整合为一行：CI-XI 69.82%、CI-XA 34.20%、O(6)H···O(3′)相对含量 23.56%、O(3)H···O(5)相对含量 34.92%。 [2][4][8]
其中CI-XI 69.82%与CI-XA 34.20%取自第6页的Table 1(a)“The CI of softwood fibers through refining”，该表16,000转行依次列出 69.82 与 34.20。 [1][2]
O(6)H···O(3′) 23.56%与O(3)H···O(5) 34.92%取自第8页的Table 2(a)“The relative content of three H-bonds and the free OH for softwood fibers through refining”，该表16,000转行为 23.56、34.92、29.38、12.14，拟合 r²=0.9996。 [3][4]
因此这四项数值分属两张表：两项结晶度指标来自Table 1(a)，两项氢键相对含量来自Table 2(a)，并非出自同一张表。 [1][3]
单位与口径：Table 1表头把CI标为“CI (%)”，论文正文亦以百分数讨论CI-XI与CI-XA（如“reduction of 4.66% and 15.47%”）；Table 2表头未印“%”号，但正文用“28.23%”到“26.05%”描述Table 2a的O(6)H···O(3′)列，可见表中数值为百分数，且该相对含量是按峰面积比例计算的。 [9][5][6][7]
Table 1(a)与Table 2(a)的该行只列单一数值（Table 2(a)另列r²=0.9996），表中未见重复测量的标准差，故这四项数值的误差范围无法由这两张表确定。 [2][4]

  {
    "ref": "[1]",

    "page_end": 10,
    "text": "In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood ﬁber, the trend of content\ncan be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of reﬁning\nfrom 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26%\nin the last reﬁning stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood ﬁber, it increased\nﬁrstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both ﬁbers, the content of\nO(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of reﬁning from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to\nthe fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than\nO(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend\nin general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the\nbreakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and\nhigher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose\nmore accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber,\nthe number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions\nincreasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to\n12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups,\nwhich makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H···O(6) or O(6)H···O(3′)H-bonds. Thus although\nthere is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6)\nmight disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H···O(3′) or the O(2)H···O(6) H-bonds might increase\nupon drying.\n\n3.4. Correlation between CI and Content of Inter-Molecular H-Bonds during PFI Reﬁning\nSimilar to the CI-XI, the content of O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds decreased ﬁrst and then had an increase,\nfollowed by a decline for the two ﬁbers (as shown in Figure 8a,b). Besides, the Pearson correlation\ncoeﬃcients were calculated between the content of H-bonds and the CI-XI. It was 0.912 (p < 0.05)\nfor softwood ﬁbers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The similar trends in the\ncontent of the O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds and the CI-XI might be because that the crystalline region has a\nhigher content of O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds when compared with the amorphous regions, as illustrated\nin Figure 9 [35].",

The results showed that\nthe polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost\nunchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed\nwith reﬁning. 针叶木（softwood fiber）的O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键含量与CI-XI（由XRD峰强度得到的结晶度指数）的Pearson相关系数为0.912（p < 0.05）。[1][2]
论文3.4节在同一处给出阔叶木（hardwood fiber）的对应相关系数为0.889（p < 0.05），即正文中针叶木与阔叶木分别为0.912与0.889。[1]
但论文摘要把同一相关性的针叶木数值写为0.888（p < 0.05）、阔叶木为0.889（p < 0.05），与正文3.4节的0.912不一致。[3]
论文未说明摘要0.888与正文0.912之间的差异，因此两处数值不能同时成立，仅凭本文无法确定哪一个是最终值。
论文结论把该关系表述为显著正相关，并认为可依据CI-XI大致推测O(6)H···O(3′)氢键含量的变化趋势。[4][5]

PyMuPDF结构版81块

PFI打浆的机械作用首先引起内部细纤维化，即纤维壁分层、松弛和润胀。 [2]
同时发生外部细纤维化，即从纤维表面剥离仍附着的微细纤维，并伴随纤维切断和细小纤维形成。 [2]
这些作用提高纤维的可及性、润胀性、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力。 [2]
随PFI打浆转数增加，打浆度和WRV显著升高，原因是细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙。 [1]
WRV升高表示纤维润胀增强，使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [1]
纸页抗张强度的增量主要来自PFI打浆过程中不断增强的细纤维化和细小纤维。 [3]
纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起重要作用，而零距抗张结果表明PFI打浆未降低纤维自身强度。 [3]
文献在讨论强度时把干抗张强度增量主要归因于细纤维化和细小纤维，但没有给出纤维长度、细小纤维和WRV三者贡献大小的定量排序。 [1] [3]

The Morphological Analysis, Swelling, and Mechanical Properties\nFor softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, the macro-ﬁbrillation index and the ﬁber length had\na downward trend, and the ﬁnes content has an upward trend for the softwood ﬁbers during PFI\nreﬁning, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-ﬁbrillation index and ﬁber length of softwood ﬁbers\nchanged signiﬁcantly. However, two parameters of hardwood ﬁbers had no signiﬁcant variations\nrelative to softwood ﬁbers. It might be because of the lower reﬁning pressure that was applied in\nhardwood ﬁbers. The macro-ﬁbrillation index characterizes external macro-ﬁbrillation. The results of\nﬁber morphology analysis showed that external ﬁbrillation increased with the reﬁning process. It is\nconsistent with the increasing speciﬁc surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource).\n\nFigure 1. It is caused by the higher ﬁbrillation that produces the\nnew surface and more pores (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource). The increase in swelling\ncharacterized by WRV makes the ﬁbers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to\nimproving the inter-ﬁber bonding strength of the ﬁber network.     "text": "Keywords: natural cellulosic ﬁbers; mechanical reﬁning; Crystallinity; Crystallite size;\nHydrogen bonds\n\n1. Introduction\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired\nphysical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic ﬁbers. Therein,\nPapirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) reﬁning is the most common laboratory reﬁner in order to\nimprove the inter-ﬁber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-ﬁbrillated\nor nano-ﬁbrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main eﬀects of PFI reﬁning on ﬁbers are: (i) internal\nﬁbrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of ﬁber wall; (ii) external ﬁbrillation—peeling of\nﬁbrils from the ﬁber surface while remaining attached; (iii) ﬁber shortening—ﬁber cutting due to\nshearing action, and (iv) ﬁnes formation—primary ﬁnes come from ray cells and parenchyma cells\nand microﬁbrils that are caused by ﬁber shortening or external ﬁbrillation. Moreover, the PFI reﬁning\ncould be adopted to obtain a higher internal ﬁbrillation than other laboratory reﬁners [1]. These eﬀects\nof the PFI reﬁning on cellulosic ﬁbers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the ﬂexibility, and the\ninter-ﬁber bonding capacity of ﬁbers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and\nproperties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during reﬁning [7,8].\n\nThere are some diﬀerent conclusions regarding to the eﬀects of PFI reﬁning on crystallinity of\ncellulose, not like that of ball milling, which eﬀectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment\nprogresses. MinerU原生文本117块

PFI打浆对纤维的主要作用包括内部分丝（细胞壁分层、松弛和润胀）、外部分丝（从纤维表面剥离但仍附着的微纤丝）、纤维缩短和细小纤维生成。 [1]
这些PFI打浆作用会提高纤维的可及性、润胀性、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力。 [1]
随PFI打浆转数增加，打浆度和WRV显著上升，这归因于更高程度的分丝产生新表面和更多孔隙；WRV所反映的润胀使纤维横向更柔顺，有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [2]
纸张抗张强度的提高主要归因于PFI打浆过程中的分丝和细小纤维。 [3]
纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起关键作用，软木浆湿纸幅强度增幅比硬木浆更显著；同时零-span抗张指数显示PFI打浆没有降低纤维强度。 [3]

luna：要点66.67%；事实5/5；引用5/5；引用组5/5；边界1/2。

The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }

    "text": "1. Introduction\n\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.",

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

PFI打浆对纤维的主要作用包括内部纤维化（纤维壁分层、松弛和润胀）、外部纤维化（从纤维表面剥离仍附着的纤丝）、纤维缩短和细小纤维生成。 [3]
这些作用会提高纤维的可及性、润胀、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力。 [3]
随着PFI打浆转数增加，打浆度和WRV显著提高，原因是更高程度的纤维化产生了新的表面和更多孔隙。 [2] [5]
以WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [2]
纸页拉伸强度的增量主要归因于PFI打浆过程中增加的纤维化和细小纤维。 [1]
PFI打浆提高了纤维化程度（尤其是内部纤维化）、纤维润胀和纸页拉伸强度，同时没有降低纤维本身的拉伸强度。 [1]
针叶木纤维的湿纸幅强度增幅比阔叶木纤维更显著，这是因为纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起关键作用。 [1]
PFI打浆过程中针叶木纤维的宏观纤维化指数和纤维长度呈下降趋势，细小纤维含量呈上升趋势，且外部纤维化随打浆过程增加。 [5]

DSH归档对照

DSH

PFI 打浆（Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut refining）是实验室最常用的打浆设备，其目的就是提高纤维间结合能力（inter-fiber bonding capacity）和可及性（accessibility）。 [1]
原文把 PFI 打浆对纤维的主要作用概括为四类：内细纤维化——纤维壁的分层、疏松与润胀；外细纤维化——纤丝从纤维表面剥离但仍附着在纤维上；纤维变短——剪切作用造成的纤维切断；细小纤维生成——来自射线细胞和薄壁细胞的原生细小纤维，以及纤维切断或外细纤维化产生的微细纤维。 [2] [3] [4] [5]
这几类作用会共同提高纤维的可及性、润胀、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力，这是纸页变结实的宏观结构基础。 [6]
作者还指出，PFI 打浆比其他实验室打浆设备能获得更高的内细纤维化程度。 [7]
形态学实测与之一致：针叶木浆的宏观细纤维化指数和纤维长度随打浆呈下降趋势、细小纤维含量上升；阔叶木浆这两个参数相对针叶木无显著变化，作者归因于其打浆压力更低。 [8] [9]
打浆度（SR）与保水值 WRV 随打浆转数显著升高，原因是更强的细纤维化产生了新表面和更多孔隙；原文进一步说明，WRV 所表征的润胀使纤维横向更柔顺，从而有助于提高纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [10] [11] [12]
力学上，抗张指数、零距抗张指数和湿纸幅强度都作为打浆转数的函数被测得，抗张强度出现增量；作者把这一增量主要归因于打浆中不断增加的细纤维化和细小纤维，湿纸幅强度在针叶木上提升更明显则是因为纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起关键作用；零距抗张结果说明打浆没有降低单根纤维的强度。 [13] [14] [15] [16]
该节小结：PFI 打浆提高了（尤其是内）细纤维化程度、纤维的润胀以及纸页的抗张强度，同时没有降低纤维本身的抗张强度。 [17]
分子尺度上，打浆没有改变氢键能量和氢键距离，因为三类氢键的吸收峰位几乎没有发生红移或蓝移；也就是说，变化的不是单个氢键的强度或长度，而是各类氢键的相对含量。 [18] [19]
含量层面：O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键整体减少（针叶木 16.54%、阔叶木 5.91%），O(3)H···O(5) 分子内氢键整体增加（针叶木 22.78%、阔叶木 8.8%）；同时结晶度指数下降，CI-XI 与 CI-XA 在针叶木上分别降低 4.66% 和 15.47%，在阔叶木上分别降低 2.65% 和 19.4%。 [20] [21] [22]
作者把这些超分子变化接到宏观性能上：分子间氢键减少与结晶度降低会因分子链运动性、可及性和 WRV 提高而进一步提高纤维柔顺性；O(3)H···O(5) 氢键增多则会提高纤维素刚度。O(6)H···O(3′) 的减少被归因于 PFI 打浆机械作用下的纤维素分子链断裂，并与内、外细纤维化密切相关。 [23] [24] [25]
把上述环节串成一条链，本文描述的“一步步”机制是：打浆的机械与剪切作用 → 内、外细纤维化、纤维切断与细小纤维生成 → 新表面和孔隙增多 → 润胀（WRV 升高）、纤维横向更柔顺、可及性提高，并伴随氢键网络重排（分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 减少、分子内 O(3)H···O(5) 增多）与结晶度下降 → 纤维间结合面积与结合强度提高 → 纸页抗张强度与湿纸幅强度上升，而单根纤维强度基本不下降。 [6] [11] [12] [16] [17] [23]
结论把两个层面并列：PFI 打浆不仅作用于宏观结构与力学性能，也作用于包括微晶尺寸、结晶度和各类氢键含量在内的超分子结构。 [26]
回到三个因素的排序：论文对强度增量唯一使用“主要由……造成”（mainly caused by）这类明确归因措辞的对象是“细纤维化和细小纤维”，即细小纤维（连同细纤维化）被作者点名为纸页抗张强度提高的主因。 [13]
纤维长度的角色不同：它只在湿纸幅强度上被强调为起关键作用；而且针叶木浆的纤维长度随打浆下降、纸页强度却在上升，阔叶木浆的纤维长度与宏观细纤维化无显著变化、其湿纸幅强度的增幅也明显小于针叶木。按本文数据，纤维长度不能解释纸页随打浆变结实。 [14] [8] [9] [15]
WRV 更接近因果链中的中间环节：它本身是细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙的结果，原文只说它表征的润胀使纤维横向更柔顺、“有助于”提高纤维网络的结合强度，并未把它与细纤维化或细小纤维做并列的贡献比较。据此推断，把 WRV 与细小纤维并列排序会与其成因重复计数。 [11] [12]
证据边界：论文没有给出纤维长度、细小纤维、WRV 三者对抗张强度贡献的定量分解（没有相对贡献率，没有回归系数，也没有只改变单一变量的对比试验），因此严格的“哪个贡献最大”无法由本文数据判定。

luna：要点100.00%；事实12/16；引用39/39；引用组10/16；边界2/2。

      "text": "WRV 更接近因果链中的中间环节：它本身是细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙的结果，原文只说它表征的润胀使纤维横向更柔顺、“有助于”提高纤维网络的结合强度，并未把它与细纤维化或细小纤维做并列的贡献比较。据此推断，把 WRV 与细小纤维并列排序会与其成因重复计数。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "B042",
      "basis": {
        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. It is consistent with the increasing specific surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource). The beating degree and the WRV had a significant increment with increasing PFI refining revolutions, as can be seen in Figure 2 . It is caused by the higher fibrillation that produces the new surface and more pores (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource). The increase in swelling characterized by WRV makes the fibers more compliant in transverse [ 1 ], which contributes to improving the inter-fiber bonding strength of the fiber network. The results of fiber morphology analysis and water retention value showing that the fibrillation and the separation between fibrils increase with the refining process. In Figure 3 , the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represe",

      }

    {

      "text": "证据边界：论文没有给出纤维长度、细小纤维、WRV 三者对抗张强度贡献的定量分解（没有相对贡献率，没有回归系数，也没有只改变单一变量的对比试验），因此严格的“哪个贡献最大”无法由本文数据判定。",

  "reasons": {
    "basis_C1": "该段说明PFI打浆旨在提高纤维间结合能力和可及性。",
    "basis_C2": "该段列出内、外细纤维化、纤维变短和细小纤维生成四类作用及其定义。",
    "basis_C3": "该段说明这些作用会改善可及性、润胀、柔顺性和纤维间结合能力。",
    "basis_C4": "该段直接比较PFI与其他实验室打浆设备的内细纤维化程度。",
    "basis_C5": "该段涵盖针叶木的形态趋势及阔叶木变化较小、可能与较低打浆压力有关。",
    "basis_C6": "该段说明打浆度和WRV上升，并将其联系到细纤维化、新表面、孔隙及结合强度。",
    "basis_C7": "该段同时涉及抗张、湿纸幅和零距抗张结果及相关解释。",
    "basis_C8": "该段总结细纤维化、润胀和纸页抗张改善，且纤维强度未降低。",
    "basis_C9": "该段说明峰位基本不变，因而氢键能量和距离未变。",
    "basis_C10": "氢键含量变化与两种CI降幅分别由不同段落和表格支持，单段不足以覆盖全部。",
    "basis_C11": "此复合陈述涉及不同氢键、结晶度及链断裂解释，没有单段完整涵盖。",
    "basis_C12": "该因果链涉及多个阶段和指标，单一段落不足以直接证明整条链。",
    "basis_C13": "结论段明确并列宏观结构、力学性能与超分子结构变化。",
    "basis_C14": "该段明确把抗张强度增量主要归因于细纤维化和细小纤维。",
    "basis_C15": "该段说明纤维长度对湿纸幅强度重要，并另述纸页抗张增量的主要归因。",
    "basis_C16": "该段支持细纤维化产生新表面和孔隙，以及WRV表征的润胀有助于结合。",
    "basis_C17": "这是关于缺少独立贡献分解的证据边界，所给单段均未直接证明该缺失。",
    "boundary": "回答了打浆增强纸页的定性链条，并指出论文没有给出三因素的独立贡献排名或定量分解。",
    "citation_C10_1": "所附引文直接支持针叶木和阔叶木的O(6)H···O(3′)氢键总量下降。",
    "citation_C10_2": "所附引文直接支持两类纤维的O(3)H···O(5)氢键含量上升。",
    "citation_C10_3": "所附引文直接支持两类纤维CI-XI与CI-XA的下降幅度。",
    "citation_C11_1": "所附引文支持较少分子间氢键和较低CI与柔顺性提高的联系。",
    "citation_C11_2": "所附引文直接支持O(3)H···O(5)氢键增多会增强纤维素刚度。",
    "citation_C11_3": "所附引文支持O(6)H···O(3′)减少可能源于分子链断裂，并与内外细纤维化相关。",
    "citation_C12_1": "所附引文支持打浆作用改善可及性、润胀、柔顺性及纤维间结合能力。",
    "citation_C12_2": "所附引文支持较强细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙。",
    "citation_C12_3": "所附引文支持WRV表征的润胀提高横向柔顺性并有助于纤维网络结合。",
    "citation_C12_4": "所附引文支持零距抗张结果显示打浆未降低纤维强度。",
    "citation_C12_5": "所附引文概括了细纤维化、润胀和纸页抗张改善且纤维强度未下降。",
    "citation_C12_6": "所附引文支持较少分子间氢键和较低CI与柔顺性提高的关系。",

      "text": "把上述环节串成一条链，本文描述的“一步步”机制是：打浆的机械与剪切作用 → 内、外细纤维化、纤维切断与细小纤维生成 → 新表面和孔隙增多 → 润胀（WRV 升高）、纤维横向更柔顺、可及性提高，并伴随氢键网络重排（分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 减少、分子内 O(3)H···O(5) 增多）与结晶度下降 → 纤维间结合面积与结合强度提高 → 纸页抗张强度与湿纸幅强度上升，而单根纤维强度基本不下降。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "basis": null
    },
    {
      "id": "C13",
      "text": "结论把两个层面并列：PFI 打浆不仅作用于宏观结构与力学性能，也作用于包括微晶尺寸、结晶度和各类氢键含量在内的超分子结构。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E22",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C14",
      "text": "回到三个因素的排序：论文对强度增量唯一使用“主要由……造成”（mainly caused by）这类明确归因措辞的对象是“细纤维化和细小纤维”，即细小纤维（连同细纤维化）被作者点名为纸页抗张强度提高的主因。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C15",
      "text": "纤维长度的角色不同：它只在湿纸幅强度上被强调为起关键作用；而且针叶木浆的纤维长度随打浆下降、纸页强度却在上升，阔叶木浆的纤维长度与宏观细纤维化无显著变化、其湿纸幅强度的增幅也明显小于针叶木。按本文数据，纤维长度不能解释纸页随打浆变结实。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C16",
      "text": "WRV 更接近因果链中的中间环节：它本身是细纤维化产生新表面和更多孔隙的结果，原文只说它表征的润胀使纤维横向更柔顺、“有助于”提高纤维网络的结合强度，并未把它与细纤维化或细小纤维做并列的贡献比较。据此推断，把 WRV 与细小纤维并列排序会与其成因重复计数。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E13",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The beating degree and the WRV had a significant increment with increasing PFI refining revolutions, as can be seen in Figure 2. It is caused by the higher fibrillation that produces the new surface and more pores (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource). The increase in swelling characterized by WRV makes the fibers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to improving the inter-fiber bonding strength of the fiber network. The results of fiber morphology analysis and water retention value showing that the fibrillation and the separation between fibrils increase with the refining process."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C17",
      "text": "证据边界：论文没有给出纤维长度、细小纤维、WRV 三者对抗张强度贡献的定量分解（没有相对贡献率，没有回归系数，也没有只改变单一变量的对比试验），因此严格的“哪个贡献最大”无法由本文数据判定。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "basis": null
    }
  ],

    "text": "2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Reﬁning\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp ﬁbers were obtained from\nZhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI reﬁner\n(Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency\nof 10%, the gap between the opposite reﬁning plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were\n3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp\nﬁbers were separately reﬁned in a PFI reﬁner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and\nat 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an\nincreasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood ﬁbers and 0,\n26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\nThe ﬁnes content, weighted mean length, and macro-ﬁbrillation index of each sample were\ndetermined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of\ndry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT\n12914-2008, respectively. The Morphological Analysis, Swelling, and Mechanical Properties\nFor softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, the macro-ﬁbrillation index and the ﬁber length had\na downward trend, and the ﬁnes content has an upward trend for the softwood ﬁbers during PFI\nreﬁning, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-ﬁbrillation index and ﬁber length of softwood ﬁbers\nchanged signiﬁcantly. However, two parameters of hardwood ﬁbers had no signiﬁcant variations\nrelative to softwood ﬁbers. It might be because of the lower reﬁning pressure that was applied in\nhardwood ﬁbers. The macro-ﬁbrillation index characterizes external macro-ﬁbrillation. The results of\nﬁber morphology analysis showed that external ﬁbrillation increased with the reﬁning process. It is\nconsistent with the increasing speciﬁc surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource).\n\nFigure 1. The increase in swelling\ncharacterized by WRV makes the ﬁbers more compliant in transverse [1], which contributes to\nimproving the inter-ﬁber bonding strength of the ﬁber network. 原固定44块

针叶木浆与阔叶木浆经0、4000、8000、12000、16000转PFI打浆后的累积孔体积、平均孔径和比表面积数据列于补充材料Table S1中。 [2]
所提供证据片段中未给出Table S1的具体数值，因此无法确定针叶木打浆至8000转时的BET比表面积数值。 [2]
纤维形态分析显示外部细纤维化随打浆过程增强，这与比表面积的增大相一致。 [7]
打浆使细纤维化程度提高，产生新的表面和更多孔隙，从而使比表面积增大。 [5]

方法部分仅说明干纸抗张强度按TAPPI T494测试，未提供针叶木8000转组的平行实验明细。 [1]
在所提供的证据中，未见针叶木8000转组干纸抗张指数的每次平行实验原始数据。 [1] [6]
图3按针叶木纤维和阔叶木纤维分别展示，因此针叶木8000转的数据应属于图3a所示曲线，但证据未给出其重复测量值。 [6]
文中8000转对应的表格数据为结晶度与晶粒尺寸，并非干纸抗张指数。 [4]

        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

Two pulp were treated with a PFI reﬁner\n(Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency\nof 10%, the gap between the opposite reﬁning plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were\n3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp\nﬁbers were separately reﬁned in a PFI reﬁner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and\nat 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an\nincreasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood ﬁbers and 0,\n26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\nThe ﬁnes content, weighted mean length, and macro-ﬁbrillation index of each sample were\ndetermined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of\ndry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT\n12914-2008, respectively. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing\nﬁbrillation and ﬁnes during PFI reﬁning, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood\nﬁber had a more signiﬁcant increase when compared to that of hardwood ﬁber. It is for that ﬁber\nlength plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in\ncharacterizing the tensile strength of ﬁbers. The rheological analysis of wet sheets, the tensile strength of dry sheets, and the ﬁber strength\nfor unreﬁned and reﬁned samples: (a) softwood ﬁbers and (b) hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n3.2. Eﬀect of PFI Reﬁning on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\nThe cellulose polymorph of these two ﬁbers had no change during PFI treatment, which illustrates\nthat the PFI reﬁning is a relatively mild mechanical treatment, as the results of XRD in Online Resource\n(Figures S1 and S2) show. In general, the CI-XI and the CI-XA of softwood ﬁbers showed a reduction\nof 4.66% and 15.47%, respectively, and those of hardwood ﬁbers decreased by 2.65% and 19.4%,\nrespectively, as can be seen in Figure 4 and Table 1. The value of the CI-XI was remarkably higher than\nthe CI-XA, which might be caused by the over-ﬁtting of amorphous contribution in the analysis of\nCI-XA. However, the CI-XI and the CI-XA were correlated signiﬁcantly for both softwood ﬁbers and\nhardwood ﬁbers, with a correlation coeﬃcient of 0.919 (p < 0.05) for softwood ﬁbers and 0.925 (p < 0.05)\nfor hardwood ﬁbers, respectively, which is consistent with the report of Ahvenainen et al.       "text": "所给证据未提供针叶木8000转条件下干纸抗张指数每次平行实验的原始数据。",
      "claim_type": "scope",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

    "text": "2.1. PFI Refining\n\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79<sup>◦</sup> SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70<sup>◦</sup> SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\n\nThe fines content, weighted mean length, and macro-fibrillation index of each sample were determined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of dry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT 12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus (Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361.",

无法提供：这篇论文没有给出针叶木（softwood）8000 转组干纸抗张指数逐次平行实验的原始数据，正文和表格中都不存在这样的数据表。[1][2]
8000 转是论文设置的五个磨浆水平之一，即 0、4000、8000、12,000 和 16,000 转。[4]
干纸抗张强度的测定方法只写到按 TAPPI T494 与（湿纸幅的）GB/T 12914-2008 标准执行，未提及平行次数、重复测量结果或标准差。[3]
抗张指数在全文只以图 3 的形式出现：正文说明 tensile index、zero-span tensile index 与 wet-web strength 是随磨浆转数变化的关系。[1]
图 3(a) 为针叶木纤维、图 3(b) 为阔叶木纤维；图注说明该图给出湿纸幅流变分析、干纸抗张强度与纤维强度的结果。[2]
图 3(a) 中每个转数只画出一个带误差棒的数据点，没有任何数值标注，也没有逐次平行测定的数值。[2]
按图 3(a) 坐标轴读图，8000 转处干纸抗张指数（红色方点，图例单位 N·m/g）约为 75 N·m/g；这是读图估计值，不是论文正文给出的数字。[2]
针叶木 8000 转组在论文中确有具体数值的是结晶度：表 1(a) 该行为 CI-XI 72.54%、CI-XA 39.65%（后三列为微晶尺寸 3.2、3.4、4.6 nm）。[5][8]
同组的氢键相对含量见表 2(a)：8000 转时 O(6)HO(3′) 为 28.43%、O(3)HO(5) 为 30.86%、O(2)HO(6) 为 25.87%、自由 OH 为 14.84%（拟合 r² = 0.9995）。[6][9]
论文列出的补充材料只有 Figure S1–S4 与 Table S1（累积孔体积、平均孔径、比表面积），其中同样没有抗张指数数据。[7]
因此，每次平行实验的原始抗张指数只能向作者索取原始记录；该 PDF 内不含这部分数据，任何具体到单次平行的数值都缺乏依据。

PFI2-027 · 这篇论文对干纸抗张性能有什么结论？另外请给出同一批样品的耐破指数和撕裂指数精确数据。

参考答案与评分要点
可回答部分：作者报告PFI打浆提高纸页抗张性能，并将其与细纤维化及细小纤维增加联系。无法回答部分：当前正文没有报告同批样品耐破指数和撕裂指数的精确数据，需要相应试验资料，不能由抗张结果直接换算。

PyMuPDF结构版81块

PFI精磨带来的抗张强度增量主要来自精磨过程中不断增加的细纤维化与细小组分。 [1]
零-span抗张指数结果表明PFI精磨没有降低纤维强度，这与Kouko等人的报道一致。 [1]
上述结果表明，PFI精磨提高了细纤维化（尤其是内部细纤维化）程度、纤维润胀以及纸页抗张强度，而纤维的抗张强度并未下降。 [1]
所提供的证据仅涉及抗张强度、零-span抗张强度、湿纸幅强度等测试，未包含耐破指数与撕裂指数的任何数值，故无法给出这两个指标的精确数据。 [1] [4]

    {
      "id": "C1",
      "text": "PFI精磨带来的抗张强度增量主要来自精磨过程中不断增加的细纤维化与细小组分。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing\nﬁbrillation and ﬁnes during PFI reﬁning, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood\nﬁber had a more signiﬁcant increase when compared to that of hardwood ﬁber. It is for that ﬁber\nlength plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in\ncharacterizing the tensile strength of ﬁbers. [24].\nThe above results showed that PFI reﬁning improved the extent of ﬁbrillation (especially the internal\nﬁbrillation), the swelling of ﬁbers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile\nstrength of ﬁbers.\n\nFigure 3. The rheological analysis of wet sheets, the tensile strength of dry sheets, and the ﬁber strength\nfor unreﬁned and reﬁned samples: (a) softwood ﬁbers and (b) hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n3.2. Eﬀect of PFI Reﬁning on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\nThe cellulose polymorph of these two ﬁbers had no change during PFI treatment, which illustrates\nthat the PFI reﬁning is a relatively mild mechanical treatment, as the results of XRD in Online Resource\n(Figures S1 and S2) show. In general, the CI-XI and the CI-XA of softwood ﬁbers showed a reduction\nof 4.66% and 15.47%, respectively, and those of hardwood ﬁbers decreased by 2.65% and 19.4%,\nrespectively, as can be seen in Figure 4 and Table 1. The value of the CI-XI was remarkably higher than\nthe CI-XA, which might be caused by the over-ﬁtting of amorphous contribution in the analysis of\nCI-XA. However, the CI-XI and the CI-XA were correlated signiﬁcantly for both softwood ﬁbers and\nhardwood ﬁbers, with a correlation coeﬃcient of 0.919 (p < 0.05) for softwood ﬁbers and 0.925 (p < 0.05)\nfor hardwood ﬁbers, respectively, which is consistent with the report of Ahvenainen et al.     "text": "2.1. PFI Reﬁning\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp ﬁbers were obtained from\nZhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. 论文指出，干纸抗张强度的提高主要源于PFI打浆过程中细纤维化和细小纤维的增加。 [1]
图3显示抗张指数、零距抗张指数和湿纸幅强度随打浆转数变化，抗张指数随打浆转数增加而升高。 [1]
零距抗张指数结果表明PFI打浆未降低纤维自身强度，打浆提高了纤维润胀程度和纸张抗张强度。 [1]
所给证据仅涉及抗张指数、零距抗张指数、湿纸幅强度以及结晶结构与氢键等内容，未包含耐破指数和撕裂指数的数据。 [1] [4]

      "text": "论文指出，干纸抗张强度的提高主要源于PFI打浆过程中细纤维化和细小纤维的增加。",
      "claim_type": "fact",

      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

PFI精磨提高了细纤维化程度（尤其是内部细纤维化）和纤维的润湿膨胀，并提高了纸页的抗张强度。 [6]
纸页抗张强度的增加主要归因于PFI精磨过程中不断增加的细纤维化和细组分。 [6]
零-span抗张指数结果表明PFI精磨没有降低纤维强度，因此纸页抗张强度的提高并非来自纤维强度下降。 [6]
所提供的证据中，力学性能测试与结果集中在抗张强度、零-span抗张指数和湿纸幅强度，未给出同一批样品的耐破指数和撕裂指数精确数据。 [1] [6]

DSH归档对照

DSH

论文对干纸抗张性能的结论是：PFI 精磨提高干纸页的抗张强度（tensile strength），其增量主要来自精磨过程中纤维分丝帚化（fibrillation）与细小纤维（fines）的增加；干纸页抗张性能以 tensile index、zero-span tensile index 和湿纸幅强度随精磨转数变化的曲线（Figure 3）给出。
论文指出，zero-span 抗张指数的结果表明 PFI 精磨并未降低纤维（单根纤维）的强度，该结果与 Kouko 等人的报道一致。
作者据此总结：PFI 精磨提高了帚化程度（尤其是内部帚化）和纤维的润湿膨胀，并在不降低纤维抗张强度的前提下提高了纸页的抗张强度。
需要区分的是，论文没有在正文或表格中列出 tensile index 等抗张指标的具体数值，这些结果只以 Figure 3 的曲线（带误差棒的数据点；内容为湿纸幅流变、干纸页抗张强度与纤维强度，分软木和硬木）呈现。
关于第二问：本论文没有报告耐破指数（burst index）和撕裂指数（tear index），因此无法给出“同一批样品”的这两项精确数据。
依据是论文 2.2 节的纸页强度测试只包含干纸页抗张强度（按 TAPPI T494）、湿纸幅强度以及按 ISO 15361 测定的 zero-span 抗张强度，没有耐破或撕裂测试。
论文中的定量表格为 Table 1（CI-XI、CI-XA 与微晶尺寸）和 Table 2（三种氢键及自由 OH 的相对含量），均不含耐破或撕裂指数；补充材料 Table S1 给出的是累积孔体积、平均孔径与比表面积，也不是强度指标。
因此，所问的耐破指数与撕裂指数精确数值在本 PDF 内没有依据，属于论文未报告、无法确定的内容，不应用其他来源或推断填充。

The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."

PyMuPDF结构版81块

所给证据中的Li-2020 PFI论文研究了PFI精磨对纤维素聚集结构、晶胞堆积和氢键网络的影响，但所给证据未包含《Non-Wood Fibers: Relationships of Fiber Properties with Pulp Properties》的实验数据，因此无法比较两篇论文的全部实验数据或给出两篇共同结论。 [4]
PFI论文用PFI精磨处理漂白软木和硬木硫酸盐浆，精磨转数为0、4000、8000、12000和16000转。 [2]
PFI论文报告O(6)H···O(3′)分子间氢键含量与CI显著正相关，软木纤维Pearson相关系数为0.888，硬木纤维为0.889，p<0.05。 [4]
PFI论文报告PFI精磨后晶型、氢键距离和各氢键的氢键能几乎不变，而结晶指数、微晶尺寸和各类氢键含量随精磨发生变化。 [4]
PFI论文认为PFI精磨是一种对超分子结构破坏相对较小的良好机械纤丝化处理。 [1]

luna：要点100.00%；事实5/5；引用5/5；引用组5/5；边界2/2。

    "text": "Polymers 2020, 12, 2912 2 of 14\nﬁrst and then decreased with the degree of reﬁning for hardwood bleached kraft pulp ﬁbers [11] or\nfor unbleached eucalyptus ﬁbers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially\nﬂuctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating ﬂuctuation with PFI reﬁning for\ntobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identiﬁed a clear trend, but the results\nwere that the crystallinity varied during PFI reﬁnement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in\ncrystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during\nPFI reﬁning.\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure,\ncan be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl\ngroups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding\ndistance during deligniﬁcation [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used\nto study the diﬀerences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal\nregion [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during\nPFI reﬁning, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of\neucalyptus ﬁbers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that\nthe H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3′) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions\nof the content of certain H-bonds diﬀered at various reﬁning stages.\n\nThere is still a lack of literature on the eﬀects of PFI reﬁnement on the H-bonding network.\nParticularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of\nfurther study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of\nH-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, ﬂexibility,\nand ﬁbrillation of cellulosic ﬁbers during PFI reﬁnement. Therefore, this work explored the eﬀects\nof PFI reﬁnement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of\nH-bonds for softwood pulp ﬁbers and hardwood pulp ﬁbers. Attempts were made in order to establish\nthe correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.\n\n2. Methods\n\n2.1. PFI Reﬁning\nCommercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp ﬁbers were obtained from\nZhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China). Two pulp were treated with a PFI reﬁner\n(Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency\nof 10%, the gap between the opposite reﬁning plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were\n3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood ﬁbers and hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The drainability was\ncharacterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp\nﬁbers were separately reﬁned in a PFI reﬁner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and\nat 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an\nincreasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood ﬁbers and 0,\n26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood ﬁbers.\n\n2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets\nThe ﬁnes content, weighted mean length, and macro-ﬁbrillation index of each sample were\ndetermined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of\ndry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT\n12914-2008, respectively.     "text": "polymers\nArticle\nProbing Eﬀect of Papirindustriens Forskningsinstitut\n(PFI) Reﬁning on Aggregation Structure of Cellulose:\nCrystal Packing and Hydrogen-Bonding Network\nKunpeng Li, Lihong Zhao * and Beihai He\nState Key Laboratory of Pulp and Paper Engineering, South China University of Technology, 381 Wushan Rd.,\nTianhe District, Guangzhou 510640, China; felikp@mail.scut.edu.cn (K.L.); ppebhhe@scut.edu.cn (B.H.)\n* Correspondence: zhaolh@scut.edu.cn\nReceived: 17 November 2020; Accepted: 2 December 2020; Published: 4 December 2020\nAbstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that aﬀects the properties of cellulosic\nﬁbers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) reﬁning on the\nmolecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between\nthe crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic ﬁbers. The results showed that\nthe polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost\nunchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed\nwith reﬁning. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds was signiﬁcantly\ncorrelated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson\ncorrelation coeﬃcient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood ﬁbers and 0.889 (p < 0.05)\nfor hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling,\nand ﬁbrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds\nplay an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.\n\nKeywords: natural cellulosic ﬁbers; mechanical reﬁning; Crystallinity; Crystallite size;\nHydrogen bonds\n\n1. Introduction\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired\nphysical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic ﬁbers. Therein,\nPapirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) reﬁning is the most common laboratory reﬁner in order to\nimprove the inter-ﬁber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-ﬁbrillated\nor nano-ﬁbrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main eﬀects of PFI reﬁning on ﬁbers are: (i) internal\nﬁbrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of ﬁber wall; (ii) external ﬁbrillation—peeling of\nﬁbrils from the ﬁber surface while remaining attached; (iii) ﬁber shortening—ﬁber cutting due to\nshearing action, and (iv) ﬁnes formation—primary ﬁnes come from ray cells and parenchyma cells\nand microﬁbrils that are caused by ﬁber shortening or external ﬁbrillation. Moreover, the PFI reﬁning\ncould be adopted to obtain a higher internal ﬁbrillation than other laboratory reﬁners [1]. These eﬀects\nof the PFI reﬁning on cellulosic ﬁbers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the ﬂexibility, and the\ninter-ﬁber bonding capacity of ﬁbers. It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and\nproperties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during reﬁning [7,8].\n\nThere are some diﬀerent conclusions regarding to the eﬀects of PFI reﬁning on crystallinity of\ncellulose, not like that of ball milling, which eﬀectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment\nprogresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI reﬁning\nfor corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased\nPolymers 2020, 12, 2912; doi:10.3390/polym12122912 www.mdpi.com/journal/polymers",

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

在提供的证据中可识别的论文为 Li-2020 的 PFI 精磨对纤维素聚集结构影响研究，未提供《Non-Wood Fibers: Relationships of Fiber Properties with Pulp Properties》的实验数据。 [7]
PFI 论文报告：精磨后多晶型、氢键距离和各氢键能量几乎不变，而结晶指数、微晶尺寸和各氢键含量随精磨变化。 [7]
该论文指出，软木纤维和硬木纤维中 CI-XI 与 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量在 PFI 精磨过程中均呈显著正相关。 [6]
该相关性的相关系数分别为软木纤维 0.919 和硬木纤维 0.925，且 p < 0.05。 [8]
论文还认为，总体而言微晶尺寸、结晶度和各种氢键含量变化不大，PFI 精磨对超分子结构破坏相对较小。 [6]
由于缺少另一篇论文的数据，不能从现有证据判断两篇论文的全部实验数据是否一致或得出共同结论。 [7]

luna：要点100.00%；事实4/5；引用4/5；引用组3/5；边界2/2。

DSH归档对照

DSH

本题要求的比较无法完成，因此给不出两篇论文的共同结论：本会话附件中只有 paper.pdf 这一篇论文，题为《Non-Wood Fibers: Relationships of Fiber Properties with Pulp Properties》的论文及其实验数据并未随附件提供，按本题边界不属于可用材料。
附件 paper.pdf 是 Polymers 2020 年第 12 卷 2912 号文章，题名《Probing Effect of Papirindustriens Forskningsinstitut (PFI) Refining on Aggregation Structure of Cellulose: Crystal Packing and Hydrogen-Bonding Network》，作者为 Kunpeng Li、Lihong Zhao、Beihai He。 [1] [2] [3]
该文的研究对象是 PFI 精磨对纤维素分子聚集态与氢键网络（结晶度、微晶尺寸、氢键能量、氢键距离与各类氢键含量）的作用，以及晶体堆叠与氢键网络之间的关系。 [4]
其全部实验试样均为木材浆——商业漂白针叶木与阔叶木硫酸盐浆，没有非木材纤维试样；两种浆分别在 PFI 精磨机中经 0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 转处理。 [5] [6]
精磨后针叶木浆的打浆度为 16、20、40、63、79 °SR，阔叶木浆为 0、26、40、57、70 °SR。 [7]
该文也用 MORFI LB 分析仪测定了细小组分含量、加权平均长度和宏观纤丝化指数，并按 TAPPI T494 等标准测定了干纸抗张强度、湿纸幅强度和零距抗张强度，因此其数据中确实含有纤维性质与纸浆/纸张性能的部分。 [8] [9]
就该文数据本身而言，精磨过程中针叶木纤维的宏观纤丝化指数与纤维长度呈下降趋势、细小组分含量呈上升趋势。 [10]
同一文中，阔叶木纤维的宏观纤丝化指数与纤维长度相对针叶木变化不显著，作者归因于对阔叶木施加的研磨压力较低。 [11]
该文报告 PFI 精磨提高了纤丝化程度（尤其是内部纤丝化）、纤维润胀和手抄片抗张强度，同时未降低纤维本身的抗张强度。 [12]
该文的超分子结构结论是：XRD 峰强度法得到的结晶度指数与分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量显著相关，Pearson 相关系数为针叶木 0.888、阔叶木 0.889（p < 0.05）。 [18] [13]
该文认为 PFI 精磨是一种纤丝化效果好、对超分子结构破坏相对较小的机械处理。 [14]
该文的补充图表（图 S1–S4、表 S1）以在线链接形式给出，附件中只有正文 PDF，未附补充材料。 [15]
附件 PDF 共 14 页，参考文献止于第 35 条。 [16] [17]
我在该 PDF 全文（含参考文献）中检索，未出现 “Non-Wood” 字样，也未出现上述另一篇论文的题名或其文献条目，因此本附件不能提供任何与该文对照的实验数据。
结论：只能报告上述单篇论文的结果；在另一篇论文全文（尤其其纤维性质与纸浆性能数据表）未提供前，任何“两篇共同结论”的表述都会是缺乏依据的推测，故不予给出。

        "text": " Polymers (Basel) Polymers (Basel) 3589 polymers 101545357 polymers Polymers 2073-4360 Multidisciplinary Digital Publishing Institute (MDPI) PMC7761889 PMC7761889.1 7761889 7761889 33291740 10.3390/polym12122912 polymers-12-02912 1 Article Probing Effect of Papirindustriens Forskningsinstitut (PFI) Refining on Aggregation Structure of Cellulose: Crystal Packing and Hydrogen-Bonding Network Li Kunpeng Zhao Lihong * He Beihai State Key Laboratory of Pulp and Paper Engineering, South China University of Technology, 381 Wushan Rd., Tianhe District, Guangzhou 510640, China; felikp@mail.scut.edu.cn (K.L.); ppebhhe@scut.edu.cn (B.H.) * Correspondence: zhaolh@scut.edu.cn 04 12 2020 12 2020 12 12 371445 2912 17 11 2020 02 12 2020 04 12 2020 26 12 2020 19 02 2026 © 2020 by the authors. 2020 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ Licensee MDPI, Basel, Switzerland.         "document_id": "doc_0fcf2a50cfa02d21",

    {
      "id": "C3",
      "text": "该文的研究对象是 PFI 精磨对纤维素分子聚集态与氢键网络（结晶度、微晶尺寸、氢键能量、氢键距离与各类氢键含量）的作用，以及晶体堆叠与氢键网络之间的关系。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "B030",
      "basis": {
        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "cense ( http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ ). Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that affects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H⋯O(3′) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coefficient between them was 0.888 ( p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 ( p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations",
        "document_id": "doc_0fcf2a50cfa02d21",
        "start": 1000,
        "end": 2000
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C4",
      "text": "其全部实验试样均为木材浆——商业漂白针叶木与阔叶木硫酸盐浆，没有非木材纤维试样；两种浆分别在 PFI 精磨机中经 0、4000、8000、12,000、16,000 转处理。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "B036",
      "basis": {
        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "na). Two pulp were treated with a PFI refiner (Hamjern Maskin A/S, Hamar, Norway) according to Tappi T248 wd-97, with a pulp consistency of 10%, the gap between the opposite refining plates was 0.2 mm, and forces per bar length were 3.33 N/mm and 1.77 N/mm for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, respectively. The drainability was characterized by the Schopper Riegler number (SR-number) with the standards ISO 5267-1. Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions and at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79° SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70° SR were obtained for hardwood fibers. 2.2. Morphological Analysis of Fibers and Mechanical Properties of Sheets The fines content, weighted mean length, and macro-fibrillation index of each sample were determined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpa",
        "document_id": "doc_0fcf2a50cfa02d21",
        "start": 7000,
        "end": 8000
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C5",
      "text": "精磨后针叶木浆的打浆度为 16、20、40、63、79 °SR，阔叶木浆为 0、26、40、57、70 °SR。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E03",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions, respectively. Corresponding various pulps with an increasing beating degree, such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood fibers."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C6",
      "text": "该文也用 MORFI LB 分析仪测定了细小组分含量、加权平均长度和宏观纤丝化指数，并按 TAPPI T494 等标准测定了干纸抗张强度、湿纸幅强度和零距抗张强度，因此其数据中确实含有纤维性质与纸浆/纸张性能的部分。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E04",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The fines content, weighted mean length, and macro-fibrillation index of each sample were determined with a MORFI LB analyzer (Techpap SAS, Grenoble, France). The tensile strength of dry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT 12914-2008, respectively. The zero-span tensile strength was tested with the Z-Span 2400 apparatus (Pulmac International Co. Ltd., Montpelier, VT, USA), according to the standard ISO 15361."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C7",
      "text": "就该文数据本身而言，精磨过程中针叶木纤维的宏观纤丝化指数与纤维长度呈下降趋势、细小组分含量呈上升趋势。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E12",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "For softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, the macro-fibrillation index and the fiber length had a downward trend, and the fines content has an upward trend for the softwood fibers during PFI refining, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-fibrillation index and fiber length of softwood fibers changed significantly. However, two parameters of hardwood fibers had no significant variations relative to softwood fibers. It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. It is consistent with the increasing specific surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource)."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C8",
      "text": "同一文中，阔叶木纤维的宏观纤丝化指数与纤维长度相对针叶木变化不显著，作者归因于对阔叶木施加的研磨压力较低。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E12",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "For softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, the macro-fibrillation index and the fiber length had a downward trend, and the fines content has an upward trend for the softwood fibers during PFI refining, as can be seen in Figure 1. The macro-fibrillation index and fiber length of softwood fibers changed significantly. However, two parameters of hardwood fibers had no significant variations relative to softwood fibers. It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers. The macro-fibrillation index characterizes external macro-fibrillation. The results of fiber morphology analysis showed that external fibrillation increased with the refining process. It is consistent with the increasing specific surface area (as shown in Table S1 in Online Resource)."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C9",
      "text": "该文报告 PFI 精磨提高了纤丝化程度（尤其是内部纤丝化）、纤维润胀和手抄片抗张强度，同时未降低纤维本身的抗张强度。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C10",
      "text": "该文的超分子结构结论是：XRD 峰强度法得到的结晶度指数与分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量显著相关，Pearson 相关系数为针叶木 0.888、阔叶木 0.889（p < 0.05）。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E20",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The Pearson correlation coefficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C11",
      "text": "该文认为 PFI 精磨是一种纤丝化效果好、对超分子结构破坏相对较小的机械处理。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E22",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure."
      }

    }
  },
  {
    "ref": "[4]",
    "page_start": 1,
    "page_end": 1,
    "text": "This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers.",
    "verification": {
      "status": "normalized_exact",
      "extractor": "pypdf"
    }
  },
  {
    "ref": "[5]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "Commercial bleached softwood and hardwood kraft pulp fibers were obtained from Zhongzhirenhe Company (Jinan, Shandong Province, China).",
    "verification": {
      "status": "normalized_exact",
      "extractor": "pypdf"
    }
  },
  {
    "ref": "[6]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "Two pulp fibers were separately refined in a PFI refiner at 0, 4000, 8000, 12,000, and 16,000 revolutions",
    "verification": {
      "status": "normalized_exact",
      "extractor": "pypdf"
    }
  },
  {
    "ref": "[7]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "such as 16, 20, 40, 63, and 79◦SR, were obtained for softwood fibers and 0, 26, 40, 57, and 70◦SR were obtained for hardwood fibers.",
    "verification": {
      "status": "normalized_exact",
      "extractor": "pypdf"
    }
  },
  {
    "ref": "[8]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "The fines content, weighted mean length, and macro-fibrillation index of each sample were determined with a MORFI LB analyzer",
    "verification": {
      "status": "normalized_exact",
      "extractor": "pypdf"
    }
  },
  {
    "ref": "[9]",
    "page_start": 2,
    "page_end": 2,
    "text": "The tensile strength of dry sheets and Wet-web strength were tested according to TAPPI T494 and Chinese standard GBT 12914-2008, respectively.",
    "verification": {
      "status": "normalized_exact",
      "extractor": "pypdf"
    }
  },
  {
    "ref": "[10]",
    "page_start": 4,
    "page_end": 4,
    "text": "the macro-fibrillation index and the fiber length had a downward trend, and the fines content has an upward trend for the softwood fibers during PFI refining",
    "verification": {
      "status": "normalized_exact",
      "extractor": "pypdf"
    }
  },
  {
    "ref": "[11]",
    "page_start": 4,
    "page_end": 4,
    "text": "However, two parameters of hardwood fibers had no significant variations relative to softwood fibers. It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers.",
    "verification": {
      "status": "normalized_exact",
      "extractor": "pypdf"
    }
  },
  {

    "page_start": 5,
    "page_end": 5,
    "text": "The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers.",

      "extractor": "pypdf"
    }
  },
  {

  {

所提供的证据只涵盖 PFI 打浆处理、纤维形貌、保水值、XRD 与 FT-IR 分析等内容，没有涉及纸张抗张强度预测模型的训练或验证。 [1] [4]
证据中没有出现任何抗张预测模型的验证集 R² 或 RMSE 数值，因此无法据此判断最佳模型名称。 [1] [3]
表 2 中的 r2 数值（如 0.9995、0.9990）是氢键相对含量拟合的决定系数，并非抗张预测模型验证集的 R²。 [2]
这些文献中的力学测试仅包括按 TAPPI T494 等标准测定的干纸页抗张强度、湿纸幅强度和零距抗张强度，未提及预测建模。 [1] [3]

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

所提供的文献是 Li-2020 关于 PFI 打浆对纤维素聚集结构影响的研究，其方法包括纤维形态分析、保水值（WRV）、XRD 和 FT-IR 表征。 [1] [2]
该文献的结果与讨论部分集中于打浆过程中纤维形态、氢键与结晶结构的变化，未涉及纸张抗张强度预测模型。 [4] [8]
文中出现的表格与图件为孔体积、孔径、比表面积及 FT-IR 拟合曲线等补充数据，并非模型性能评价。 [3] [8]
因此，依据所给证据无法给出该预测模型验证集的 R²、RMSE 及最佳模型名称。 [1] [2]

DSH归档对照

DSH

本文没有训练或报道任何纸张抗张强度预测模型，也没有训练集/验证集划分、验证集 R² 与 RMSE 数值；因此本问题所问的验证集 R²、RMSE 和“最佳模型名称”在这篇 PDF 中不存在，无法给出（不作臆测）。
本文是一篇材料表征研究，主题是 PFI（Papirindustriens Forskningsinstitut）磨浆对纤维素聚集态结构的影响，即晶体堆砌与氢键网络。[1]
论文中的纸张抗张强度只通过实验测定：干纸页抗张强度与湿纸页强度分别按 TAPPI T494 和中国标准 GBT12914-2008 测定。[2]
零距抗张强度则用 Z-Span 2400 仪器按 ISO 15361 标准测定。[3]
抗张相关结果以抗张指数、零距抗张指数和湿纸页强度随磨浆转数变化的曲线（图3）呈现，图中是实测数据点（带误差棒）与趋势线，没有预测曲线或模型精度指标的标注。[4]
正文与表格中出现的 r² 数值仅在表2：软木纤维试样为 0.9995（0、4000、8000 转）和 0.9996（12,000、16,000 转），硬木纤维试样为 0.9990–0.9992（16,000 转降至 0.9989）。[5][6][7][8]
该 r² 与 FT-IR 羟基谱带的非线性拟合结果同表给出（正文称拟合数据见表2a 与图7），表头未标注验证集或预测，故判断它是谱峰拟合的拟合优度，而不是抗张预测模型的验证集 R²；这一判断属上下文推断，论文未明确定义该列。[9]
论文给出的定量相关性指标是 Pearson 相关系数：摘要中晶体指数与 O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键含量之间为 0.888（p<0.05，软木纤维）和 0.889（p<0.05，硬木纤维）。[10]
3.4 节给出的对应值为 0.912（p<0.05，软木纤维）和 0.889（p<0.05，硬木纤维），其中软木纤维数值与摘要的 0.888 不一致。[11][10]
结论对“由 CI-XI 推知 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量趋势”只作定性表述，并未建立可训练的预测模型。[12]

luna：要点100.00%；事实9/9；引用13/13；引用组3/9；边界2/2。

现有证据给出的结果与提问前提相反：针叶木纤维的湿纸幅强度增幅比阔叶木纤维更显著。 [2]
作者解释湿纸幅强度差异的关键因素是纤维长度，因此针叶木在该指标上的增幅更大。 [2]

      "text": "现有证据给出的结果与提问前提相反：针叶木纤维的湿纸幅强度增幅比阔叶木纤维更显著。",

The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. MinerU原生文本117块

提供的证据显示，PFI打浆后湿纸幅强度增加更显著的是针叶木，而不是阔叶木。 [1]
文献将针叶木与阔叶木湿纸幅强度增加的差异归因于纤维长度在湿纸幅强度中起关键作用。 [1]
PFI打浆过程中细纤维化和细小纤维的增加是抗张强度提高的主要原因。 [1]
PFI打浆提高了内部细纤维化、纤维润胀和纸页抗张强度，而零-span抗张指数结果表明打浆未降低纤维强度。 [1]

原固定44块

证据表明，PFI打浆后针叶木湿纸幅强度的增幅比阔叶木更显著。 [2]
该文指出，纤维长度在湿纸幅强度中起关键作用。 [2]
阔叶木的宏观纤维形态参数相对针叶木没有显著变化，可能与阔叶木采用较低的打浆压力有关。 [4]

DSH归档对照

DSH

该问题的前提与论文结果相反：论文报告的是针叶木（softwood）湿纸幅强度的增幅比阔叶木（hardwood）更显著，并没有出现阔叶木涨幅更大的结果。 [1]
论文对两种浆这一差异给出的原因只有纤维长度：纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起关键作用，所以湿纸幅强度增幅的差别被归于纤维长度差别。 [1]
据图1读数（本人读图估计）：针叶木的长度加权平均纤维长度约2 mm（0转时略高于2000 µm），阔叶木仅约0.93 mm，针叶木纤维明显更长；打浆中针叶木该长度由约2000 µm降到约1660 µm，阔叶木则基本保持在约930 µm。 [9]
论文中的湿纸幅强度（wet-web strength）对应图3给出的“Tensile index of wet sheet (N·m/g)”曲线，与抗张指数、零-span抗张指数并列随打浆转数变化。 [8][2]
据图3读数（本人读图估计，正文未列具体数值）：针叶木湿纸幅抗张指数由0转的约0.80 N·m/g升到16,000转的约4.40 N·m/g，约为原来的5.5倍、绝对增量约3.6 N·m/g；阔叶木由约0.62升到约1.79 N·m/g，约为2.9倍、绝对增量约1.2 N·m/g；绝对增量和相对倍数两种口径下都是针叶木增幅更大。 [2]
形貌结果与上述归因一致：打浆中针叶木的宏观细纤维化指数和纤维长度变化显著，而阔叶木这两项参数相对针叶木没有显著变化，论文推测原因是施加于阔叶木的打浆压力更低。 [3]
具体打浆条件为：单位齿刀长度上的作用力针叶木3.33 N/mm、阔叶木1.77 N/mm。 [4]
两种浆强度提高的普遍机制相同：抗张强度的提升主要来自打浆过程中不断增加的细纤维化与细小纤维；同时以WRV表征的润胀增加使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度。 [5][6]
论文没有给出任何“阔叶木湿纸幅强度涨幅超过针叶木”的数据或机制解释，因此该前提在本论文中没有依据，无法据本文回答“为什么阔叶木涨得更多”。
若把问题理解为相对百分比涨幅，图3中确有阔叶木相对增幅更大的指标，即零-span抗张指数（表征纤维本身的强度）：据图估计阔叶木约由152 N·m/g升到196 N·m/g（约+29%），针叶木约由140升到167 N·m/g（约+20%）；但该指标不是湿纸幅强度，论文还特别指出PFI打浆并没有降低纤维强度。 [7][2]

      "text": "该问题的前提与论文结果相反：论文报告的是针叶木（softwood）湿纸幅强度的增幅比阔叶木（hardwood）更显著，并没有出现阔叶木涨幅更大的结果。",

        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. PFI2-031 · PFI打浆把纤维素从I型变成II型以后，结晶度为什么还会下降？

参考答案与评分要点
前提不成立：论文指出两种纤维的纤维素晶型在PFI处理中没有变化（依据附件XRD图S1、S2），作者据此认为PFI打浆是较温和的机械处理。结晶度方面，0→16000转总体下降但过程有波动，例如针叶木CI-XI由73.23%到69.82%。

PyMuPDF结构版81块

XRD结果表明，PFI打浆过程中软木纤维和硬木纤维的纤维素晶型均未发生改变，说明PFI打浆是一种相对温和的机械处理，并未发生纤维素I向纤维素II的转变。 [4]
总体上，软木纤维的CI-XI和CI-XA分别下降4.66%和15.47%，硬木纤维分别下降2.65%和19.4%。 [4]
结晶度随打浆转数先下降、后上升、再下降：第一阶段的下降说明机械处理可能主要作用于结晶区，随后的下降则可能是结晶区被持续破坏。 [2]
结晶度的上升阶段被解释为机械与热作用下更强的作用力施加于无定形区，并在干燥过程中可能发生共结晶。 [2]
纤维素分子间氢键的断裂导致更充分的分层和更高的比表面积，使纤维素对水和化学试剂更易接触，这与结晶度和氢键网络的变化相关。 [7]
总体来看，晶粒尺寸、结晶度以及各类氢键的含量变化都不大，因此可认为PFI打浆是一种对超分子结构破坏相对较小的优良机械纤丝化处理。 [5]
关于PFI打浆对结晶度的影响，既有研究结论并不一致，未识别出明确趋势，只表明结晶度在PFI精磨过程中发生变化。 [3]

luna：要点100.00%；事实6/7；引用7/7；引用组6/7；边界2/2。

    "text": "Polymers 2020, 12, 2912 12 of 14\nThe results indicated that the ﬁbrillation and properties of ﬁbers are related to the variation of the\nsupramolecular structure during PFI reﬁning.     "text": "In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood ﬁber, the trend of content\ncan be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of reﬁning\nfrom 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26%\nin the last reﬁning stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood ﬁber, it increased\nﬁrstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both ﬁbers, the content of\nO(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of reﬁning from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to\nthe fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than\nO(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend\nin general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the\nbreakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and\nhigher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose\nmore accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber,\nthe number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions\nincreasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to\n12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups,\nwhich makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H···O(6) or O(6)H···O(3′)H-bonds. Thus although\nthere is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6)\nmight disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H···O(3′) or the O(2)H···O(6) H-bonds might increase\nupon drying.\n\n3.4. Correlation between CI and Content of Inter-Molecular H-Bonds during PFI Reﬁning\nSimilar to the CI-XI, the content of O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds decreased ﬁrst and then had an increase,\nfollowed by a decline for the two ﬁbers (as shown in Figure 8a,b). Besides, the Pearson correlation\ncoeﬃcients were calculated between the content of H-bonds and the CI-XI. It was 0.912 (p < 0.05)\nfor softwood ﬁbers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. MinerU原生文本117块

XRD结果表明，两种纤维在PFI处理过程中纤维素晶型没有发生变化，说明PFI打浆是相对温和的机械处理。 [3]
因此文献证据并不支持PFI打浆把纤维素由I型转变为II型这一前提。 [3]
结晶度的波动被认为源于PFI机械作用作用于纤维素的不同区域：第一阶段结晶度下降说明机械处理主要作用于结晶区。 [2]
后续结晶度再次下降被解释为结晶区被持续破坏。 [2]
软木纤维的CI-XI和CI-XA分别降低4.66%和15.47%，硬木纤维分别降低2.65%和19.4%。 [3]
水分子更容易通过亲水(110)晶面之间的准结晶区渗入，使这些晶面承受更多机械作用，从而产生更多黏附（共结晶）和纤维素链断裂。 [5]
总体而言，晶粒尺寸、结晶度以及各类氢键含量变化不大，可认为PFI是一种对超分子结构破坏相对较小的良好纤颤机械处理。 [4]

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

证据显示PFI打浆并未使纤维素晶型从I型变为II型；两种纤维的纤维素多晶型在PFI处理过程中没有变化，说明PFI是较温和的机械处理。 [8]
CI下降的第一阶段被解释为机械处理主要作用于结晶区，后续下降可能是结晶区持续破坏。 [1]
CI在PFI打浆中的波动被认为与机械作用作用于纤维素不同区域有关。 [1]
PFI打浆过程中H键网络可能发生变化。 [2]
总体上晶粒尺寸、结晶度和各种H键含量变化不大，PFI被视为对超分子结构破坏相对较小的良好纤丝化机械处理。 [5]

luna：要点100.00%；事实5/5；引用5/5；引用组5/5；边界2/2。

DSH归档对照

DSH

论文的XRD结果显示，两种浆料在PFI打浆过程中纤维素晶型没有发生变化，即仍为纤维素I；作者据此认为PFI打浆是一种较温和的机械处理。 [1]
因此，本文并没有观察到纤维素I向纤维素II的转变，也没有提供任何“转成II型之后结晶度如何变化”的数据或解释；问题中“由I型变成II型”的前提在本论文中不成立，本文无法据此解释转II后的结晶度下降。
不过，本文确实观测到结晶度下降：软木浆的CI-XI和CI-XA分别降低4.66%和15.47%，硬木浆分别降低2.65%和19.4%。 [2]
论文把结晶度的变化解释为PFI机械作用作用于纤维素不同区域的结果：打浆初期结晶度下降，说明机械处理可能主要作用于结晶区。 [3]
中间阶段的回升则被解释为更大的力作用于无定形区，并在PFI的机械与热作用下干燥时可能发生共结晶。 [4]
后续阶段的下降可能是结晶区被持续破坏所致。 [5]
在氢键层面，作者把分子间氢键含量的减少归因于PFI机械作用下纤维素分子链间的断裂，并指出这与内、外细纤维化密切相关。 [7]
CI-XI与氢键含量的Pearson相关系数为软木浆0.912、硬木浆0.889（p < 0.05）。 [8]
结晶尺寸并非全面减小：垂直于(200)晶面的微晶尺寸在打浆中呈上升趋势，作者用干燥时链的合并或相邻微纤丝的结晶学堆叠、使(200)面取向一致来解释。 [6]
氢键能量与氢键距离在打浆中未发生变化，这与晶型未变的结果一致。 [9]
论文总体上强调，微晶尺寸、结晶度和各种氢键含量变化不大，PFI打浆是细纤维化效果好、对超分子结构破坏较小的机械处理。 [10]

PFI2-032 · 论文里氢键含量和CI-XI的相关系数是针叶木0.919、阔叶木0.925吧？这么高是不是就能用CI-XI直接算出氢键含量了？

参考答案与评分要点
不对。0.919/0.925是CI-XI与CI-XA两种结晶度之间的相关系数。O(6)H···O(3′)含量与CI-XI的相关系数：摘要写针叶木0.888、阔叶木0.889，正文3.4节写针叶木0.912、阔叶木0.889，针叶木两处不一致。作者只说可据CI-XI"大致推测"该氢键含量的变化趋势，这是5个转数水平上的相关，不是经过验证的定量换算模型。

PyMuPDF结构版81块

0.919（针叶木）和0.925（阔叶木）是 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 两种结晶度指数之间的相关系数，而不是氢键含量与 CI-XI 的相关系数。 [3]
CI-XI 与 O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键含量的 Pearson 相关系数为针叶木 0.912、阔叶木 0.889（p<0.05）。 [2]
论文摘要中给出的 CI-XI 与该氢键含量相关系数为针叶木 0.888、阔叶木 0.889（p<0.05）。 [5]
作者仅指出在 PFI 磨浆过程中可基于 CI-XI 大致推测 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量的变化趋势，并未提出可由 CI-XI 直接计算出氢键含量。 [4]
研究还指出，PFI 磨浆对超分子结构破坏相对较小，结晶度和各类氢键含量总体变化不大，这也限制了用 CI-XI 直接定量氢键含量的可靠性。 [4]

luna：要点100.00%；事实4/5；引用5/5；引用组3/5；边界2/2。

    "text": "In the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood ﬁber, the trend of content\ncan be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of reﬁning\nfrom 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26%\nin the last reﬁning stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood ﬁber, it increased\nﬁrstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both ﬁbers, the content of\nO(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of reﬁning from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to\nthe fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than\nO(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend\nin general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the\nbreakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and\nhigher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose\nmore accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber,\nthe number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions\nincreasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to\n12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups,\nwhich makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H···O(6) or O(6)H···O(3′)H-bonds. Thus although\nthere is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6)\nmight disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H···O(3′) or the O(2)H···O(6) H-bonds might increase\nupon drying.\n\n3.4. Correlation between CI and Content of Inter-Molecular H-Bonds during PFI Reﬁning\nSimilar to the CI-XI, the content of O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds decreased ﬁrst and then had an increase,\nfollowed by a decline for the two ﬁbers (as shown in Figure 8a,b). Besides, the Pearson correlation\ncoeﬃcients were calculated between the content of H-bonds and the CI-XI. It was 0.912 (p < 0.05)\nfor softwood ﬁbers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. The similar trends in the\ncontent of the O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds and the CI-XI might be because that the crystalline region has a\nhigher content of O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds when compared with the amorphous regions, as illustrated\nin Figure 9 [35].",
