    "text": "polymers\nArticle\nProbing Eﬀect of Papirindustriens Forskningsinstitut\n(PFI) Reﬁning on Aggregation Structure of Cellulose:\nCrystal Packing and Hydrogen-Bonding Network\nKunpeng Li, Lihong Zhao * and Beihai He\nState Key Laboratory of Pulp and Paper Engineering, South China University of Technology, 381 Wushan Rd.,\nTianhe District, Guangzhou 510640, China; felikp@mail.scut.edu.cn (K.L.); ppebhhe@scut.edu.cn (B.H.)\n* Correspondence: zhaolh@scut.edu.cn\nReceived: 17 November 2020; Accepted: 2 December 2020; Published: 4 December 2020\nAbstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that aﬀects the properties of cellulosic\nﬁbers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) reﬁning on the\nmolecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between\nthe crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic ﬁbers. The results showed that\nthe polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost\nunchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed\nwith reﬁning. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3′) H-bonds was signiﬁcantly\ncorrelated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson\ncorrelation coeﬃcient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood ﬁbers and 0.889 (p < 0.05)\nfor hardwood ﬁbers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling,\nand ﬁbrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds\nplay an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.\n\nKeywords: natural cellulosic ﬁbers; mechanical reﬁning; Crystallinity; Crystallite size;\nHydrogen bonds",

      "status": "frozen_chunk_metadata_verified"
    }

0.919和0.925是CI-XI与CI-XA之间的相关系数，分别对应针叶木和阔叶木。 [3]
论文报告的O(6)H···O(3')分子间氢键含量与CI-XI的Pearson相关系数为针叶木0.912、阔叶木0.889。 [2]
同一论文摘要中给出的针叶木和阔叶木对应相关系数为0.888和0.889，与正文数值存在不一致。 [4]
高相关系数只表明共变关系；论文结论是可根据CI-XI推测O(6)H···O(3')氢键含量的变化趋势，而不是直接计算其含量。 [5]

    "ref": "[4]",
    "page_start": 1,
    "page_end": 1,
    "text": "Received: 17 November 2020; Accepted: 2 December 2020; Published: 4 December 2020\n\nAbstract: Supramolecular structure is the critical factor that afects the properties of cellulosic fibers. This article studied the action of Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining on the molecular aggregation and hydrogen bonding network, and tried to explore the relationship between the crystal packing and hydrogen-bonding network in cellulosic fibers. The results showed that the polymorph, H-bonding distance, and H-bonding energy of various H-bonds remained almost unchanged, while the crystalline index, crystallite size, and content of various H-bonds changed with refining. Therein, the content of the inter-molecular O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds was significantly correlated with the crystalline index that was obtained in intensities of the XRD peaks. The Pearson correlation coeficient between them was 0.888 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.889 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively. It can be concluded that the variations of accessibility, swelling, and fibrillation were closely related to the supramolecular structure and the intermolecular H-bonds play an important role in the crystal packing of cellulose.\n\nKeywords: natural cellulosic fibers; mechanical refining; Crystallinity; Crystallite size; Hydrogen bonds",
    "verification": {
      "status": "needs_source_review",
      "exact_other_pages": [],
      "note": "A text extraction mismatch is not automatically a false citation or a zero quality score."
    }

  {
    "ref": "[5]",
    "page_start": 12,
    "page_end": 12,
    "text": "The results indicated that the fibrillation and properties of fibers are related to the variation of the supramolecular structure during PFI refining. It is noticeable that there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds during PFI refining for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers. Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H· · · O(3)’ H-bonds might be generally speculated based on CI-XI while refining. Besides, the crystallite size, crystallinity, and content of various H-bonds did not change much in general. It is assumed that PFI refining is an excellent mechanical treatment of fibrillation with relatively little destruction on the supramolecular structure.\n\nSupplementary Materials: The following are available online at http://www.mdpi.com/2073-4360/12/12/2912/s1, Figure S1: XRD fitting results of softwood fibers: (a) 0, (b) 4000, (c) 8000, (d) 12,000, (e) 16,000 revolutions of PFI refining, Figure S2: XRD fitting results of hardwood fibers: (a) 0, (b) 4000, (c) 8000, (d) 12,000, (e) 16,000 revolutions of PFI refining, Figure S3: Nonlinear fitting curves of the band of hardwood fibers for hydroxyl groups: (a) 0, (b) 4000, (c) 8000, (d) 12,000, (e) 16,000 revolutions of PFI refining, Figure S4: The BET N2 adsorption/desorption isotherms at various refining revolutions of pulp fibers: (a) softwood; (b) hardwood, Table S1: Cumulative pore volume, average pore size and specific surface area of softwood pulp fiber through refining, Cumulative pore volume, average pore size and specific surface area of hardwood pulp fiber through refining.",

原固定44块归档对照

原固定44块

0.919/0.925 是 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 的相关系数，而不是氢键含量与 CI-XI 的相关系数。 [6]
正文报道 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量与 CI-XI 的 Pearson 相关系数为针叶木 0.912、阔叶木 0.889。 [2]
摘要中相应 Pearson 相关系数为针叶木 0.888、阔叶木 0.889。 [7]
O(2)H···O(6) 或自由 OH(2)、OH(6) 与 CI-XI 的相关性较差，O(3)H···O(5) 也基本不随结晶度明显变化。 [4]
因此不能直接用 CI-XI 计算氢键含量，论文仅提出在 PFI 精磨时可基于 CI-XI 大致推测 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量的趋势。 [5]

DSH归档对照

DSH

数字对应关系需要更正：论文中 0.919（针叶木）和 0.925（阔叶木）是两种结晶度指数 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 之间的相关系数（p < 0.05），不是氢键含量与 CI-XI 的相关系数。 [1]
论文同时指出 CI-XI 的数值明显高于 CI-XA，可能源于 CI-XA 分析中非晶贡献的过拟合，因此这两个指标的高一致性并不携带氢键信息。 [11]
与 CI-XI 建立相关分析的是 O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键的相对含量：正文 3.4 节给出的 Pearson 相关系数为针叶木 0.912（p < 0.05）、阔叶木 0.889（p < 0.05）。 [2]
摘要对同一相关给出的针叶木数值是 0.888（p < 0.05），阔叶木为 0.889（p < 0.05），与正文的 0.912 不一致，论文未解释这一出入。 [3]
所以不能把 0.919/0.925 当作“氢键含量—CI-XI”的相关性；按正文，可引用的氢键—CI-XI 相关只有 0.912（针叶木）和 0.889（阔叶木），并且只针对 O(6)H···O(3′) 这一种分子间氢键。 [1][2]
论文对这一相关只作趋势层面的使用：结论称可根据 CI-XI 在打浆过程中大致推测 O(6)H···O(3)′ 含量的变化趋势，并未给出回归方程、斜率、截距或换算公式（全文仅有式 (1)–(5)，分别为 WRV、CI-XI、Scherrer、氢键能、氢键距离的计算式）。 [4]
因此“用 CI-XI 直接算出氢键含量”超出了论文的支持范围：相关系数只衡量同向共变，不构成可由 CI-XI 反算含量的标定关系。 [2][4]
相关只在 O(6)H···O(3′) 上成立：O(2)H···O(6) 与自由 OH(2)/OH(6) 和 CI-XI 的相关性差，O(3)H···O(5) 因被认为稳定而未在文中讨论，所以即使要换算也不能对所有氢键套用同一关系。 [5][6]
其机理解释是结晶区的 O(6)H···O(3′) 含量高于非晶区，因此该氢键含量与 CI-XI 随打浆呈相似走势（先降、再升、后降）。 [7][8]
这里的“含量”是 FT-IR 3000–3700 cm⁻¹ 羟基谱带分峰后按各谱带面积占比算出的相对含量，不是绝对氢键数量或密度，这一口径本身也不适合被另一个指标“换算”出来。 [9][13]
论文的 CI-XI 在整个打浆过程中变化幅度很小（针叶木 4.66%、阔叶木 2.65%），用作定量换算的自变量分辨力有限（此句为据论文数据所作的推断）。 [12]
按正文数值计算（本题推断）：0.912 与 0.889 对应决定系数约 0.83 与 0.79，即 CI-XI 只能解释约八成方差，仍有约 17%–21% 的氢键含量变异无法由 CI-XI 解释。 [2]
数据基础也很有限：结论来自两种漂白硫酸盐浆在 PFI 0、4000、8000、12000、16000 转共 5 个打浆水平的数据，每个树种仅 5 个点，论文未做独立样品或跨原料验证。 [10]
结论：相关系数在 0.9 左右只说明氢键含量与 CI-XI 同向共变，不能据此由 CI-XI 直接计算氢键含量；若要定量换算，必须另行建立回归模型并做独立验证，这属于论文之外的工作（推断）。 [2]

luna：要点100.00%；事实10/14；引用19/19；引用组5/14；边界2/2。

The similar trends in the content of the O(6)H⋯O(3′) H-bonds and the CI-XI might be because that the crystalline region has a higher content of O(6)H⋯O(3′) H-bonds when compared with the amorphous regions, as illustrated in Figure 9 [ 35 ]. The correlation between the CI-XI and the O(2)H⋯O(6) H-bonds or the free OH(2) and OH(6) was poor for the following reasons. The free OH groups are easier for forming the O(2)H⋯O(6) H-bonds as opposed to the O(6)H⋯O(3′) H-bonds in the amorphous region, because the distance between adjacent glucose units in a cellulosic molecular chain is closer than between the glucose units in the adjacent molecular chain (as shown in Figure 9 ).
